title.zh: 卷229 列傳十六 明安 恩格德尔 鄂齐尔桑 阿济拜 布延 洛哩
title.en: Volume 229 Biographies 16: Ming An, En Ge De Er, E Qiersang, A Ji Bai, Bu Yan, Luo Li
title.raw: 卷229 列傳十六 明安 恩格德尔 鄂齐尔桑 阿济拜 布延 洛哩

sentences.zh: 阿濟拜恩格圖鄂本兌和濟格爾阿賴布延阿爾沙瑚額琳奇岱青德參濟旺多爾濟達爾罕奇塔特徹爾貝洛哩弟沙哩岱奇塔特偉徵

translations.literal: Aji Bai, Enggtu, Eobendui, Hejige'er, Alai, Buyan, Arshahu, Elinqidai, Qingdecen, Ji, Wang Duo'erji, Daerhan, Qitate, Che'erbei, Luoli's younger brother Shalidai, Qitate Weizheng.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Bai, Enggtu, Eobendui, Hejige'er, Alai, Buyan, Arshahu, Elinqidai, Qingdecen, Ji, Wang Duo'erji, Daerhan, Qitate, Che'erbei, Shalidai (younger brother of Luoli), and Qitate Weizheng.

sentences.zh: 奇塔特偉徵弟額爾格勒珠爾喀蘭圖扎克托會楚克圖英琿津

translations.literal: Qitate Weizheng's younger brother Ergelezhu'er, Kalandu, Zhaketuo, Huichuketu, and Yinghuanjin.
translations.idiomatic: Ergelezhu'er (younger brother of Qitate Weizheng), Kalandu, Zhaketuo, Huichuketu, and Yinghuanjin.

sentences.zh: 沙爾布}}

translations.literal: Sharubu.
translations.idiomatic: Sharubu.

sentences.zh: =明安=明安，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Ming'an. Ming'an was of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'an. Ming'an belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 其先世元裔，為蒙古科爾沁兀魯特部貝勒。

translations.literal: His ancestors were descendants of the Yuan house and he was a beile of the Khorchin Uruud tribe in Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: His family were Yuan imperial descendants, and he served as beile of the Khorchin Uruud Mongols.

sentences.zh: 歲癸巳，葉赫貝勒布寨、納林布祿糾九國之師來侵，明安與焉，戰敗，明安乘驏馬獨身跳去，尋修好於太祖。

translations.literal: In the year guisi, the Yehe beiles Buizhai and Narimbulu mustered the armies of nine states to invade; Ming'an was among them. They were defeated in battle, and Ming'an alone escaped on a swift horse. Soon afterward he made peace with the Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the guisi year, the Yehe beiles Buizhai and Narimbulu raised a coalition of nine states and marched to attack; Ming'an took part. When they were beaten, Ming'an alone fled on a fast horse. He soon reconciled with Nurhaci.

sentences.zh: 上聞明安女賢，遣使往聘，歲壬子正月，明安送女至，上具車服以迎，與宴成禮。

translations.literal: The sovereign heard that Ming'an's daughter was virtuous and sent envoys to betroth her. In the first month of the renzi year, Ming'an sent his daughter; the sovereign prepared carriage and robes to receive her and held a banquet to complete the marriage rites.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Ming'an's daughter was worthy, the sovereign sent envoys to ask for her hand. In the first month of renzi, Ming'an delivered her; Nurhaci met her with carriage and ceremonial dress and celebrated the wedding with a feast.

sentences.zh: 天命二年正月，明安來朝，上出郊百里迎諸富爾簡岡，設宴慰勞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Tianming, Ming'an came to court. The sovereign went a hundred li beyond the suburbs to welcome him at Fu'erjiangang and held a banquet to comfort and reward him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianming 2, Ming'an presented himself at court. Nurhaci went ten miles out to Fu'erjiangang to receive him and held a feast in his honor.

sentences.zh: 明安獻駝十、馬牛皆百，上優禮之，日設宴。

translations.literal: Ming'an presented ten camels and a hundred each of horses and cattle. The sovereign treated him with exceptional courtesy and held banquets daily.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'an offered ten camels and a hundred horses and cattle apiece. Nurhaci received him with high honor and entertained him at daily banquets.

sentences.zh: 留一月，明安辭，賜以四十戶，甲幣稱是，送之三十里。

translations.literal: He remained a month; when Ming'an took leave, he was granted forty households, armor and silks in proportion, and escorted thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: After a month's stay Ming'an departed; he was given forty households, commensurate armor and silks, and seen off for thirty li.

sentences.zh: 七年二月壬午，明安及同部貝勒兀爾宰圖、鎖諾木、綽乙喇札爾、達賴、密賽、拜音代、噶爾馬、昂坤、多爾濟、顧祿、綽爾齊、奇筆他爾、布顏代、伊林齊、特靈，喀爾喀部貝勒石里胡那克，並諸台吉等三千餘戶，驅其牲畜來歸，授三等總兵官，別立兀魯特蒙古一旗。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the second month of the seventh year, Ming'an and the beiles of his tribe—Urzaitu, Suonuomu, Chuoyilazha'er, Dalai, Misai, Baiyindai, Ga'erma, Angkun, Duo'erji, Gulu, Chuo'erqi, Qibita'er, Buyandai, Yilinqi, Teling—and the Khalkha beile Shilihunake, together with various taiji and more than three thousand households, drove their livestock to submit. He was appointed a third-rank zongbingguan, and a separate Uruud Mongol banner was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the second month of the seventh year, Ming'an came in with fellow beiles of his tribe—Urzaitu, Suonuomu, and the rest named above—plus the Khalkha beile Shilihunake, various taiji, and over three thousand households driving their herds. Ming'an was made third-rank zongbingguan, and a separate Uruud Mongol banner was created.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，與固山額真武訥格、額駙恩格德爾等伐察哈爾，降二千戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, together with the gushan ejen Wunage and the imperial son-in-law Enggeder, he campaigned against the Chakhar and received the surrender of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he joined Gushan Ejen Wunage and Imperial Son-in-law Enggeder in an expedition against the Chakhar, bringing two thousand households to surrender.

sentences.zh: 五年，從上伐明，圍大凌河城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he followed the sovereign in campaigning against Ming and besieged Dalinghe city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed the sovereign against the Ming and took part in the siege of Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 明總兵祖大壽出戰，明安與固山額真和碩圖等夾擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: The Ming commander-in-chief Zu Dashou came out to fight; Ming'an and the gushan ejen Heshitu and others attacked from both sides and routed him utterly.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming general Zu Dashou sallied forth, Ming'an and Gushan Ejen Heshitu struck him from both flanks and inflicted a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 我師偽為明兵赴援狀，誘大壽復出戰，明安及兩翼固山齊進奮擊，大壽敗卻，尋率眾降，明安得優賚。

translations.literal: Our army feigned the appearance of Ming troops coming to relieve the city and lured Dashou out again. Ming'an and the gushan of both wings advanced together in fierce attack; Dashou was beaten back and soon led his forces to surrender. Ming'an received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Our forces disguised themselves as Ming relief troops, drawing Dashou out a second time. Ming'an and the wing banners charged together; Dashou was driven back and soon surrendered with his army. Ming'an was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六年，從上伐察哈爾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he followed the sovereign in campaigning against the Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again followed the sovereign against the Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 師還，以俘獲少，又違令不以隸戶籍，擅以官牛與所屬，复匿蒙古亡者，吏議當奪世職，上命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because booty was scanty, because he disobeyed orders by not registering people under household rolls, because he on his own authority gave government oxen to his followers, and because he again concealed fugitive Mongols, the officials proposed that his hereditary office be stripped; the sovereign ordered a fine in lieu.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was faulted for scant spoils, for failing to register dependents on the rolls, for giving out government oxen to his men without authorization, and for sheltering fugitive Mongols. Officials recommended stripping his hereditary rank; the sovereign commuted this to a fine.

sentences.zh: 尋以內附諸蒙古所行多違令，罷蒙古旗，俱散隸諸貝勒所領牛錄，明安改隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because the submitted Mongols frequently violated orders, the Mongol banner was abolished; all were dispersed and attached to the niru led by various beiles, and Ming'an was reassigned to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, repeated violations by the submitted Mongols led to the abolition of the Mongol banner; households were scattered among the beiles' niru, and Ming'an was transferred to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，改三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, his title was changed to third-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was redesignated third-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治初，三遇恩詔，進二等伯。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, through three grace edicts he was advanced to second-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shunzhi reign, three amnesty promotions raised him to second-rank count.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡忠順。

translations.literal: He died and was given the posthumous title Zhongshun.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously titled Loyal and Compliant.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，追進一等侯，加封號恭誠。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period he was posthumously advanced to first-rank marquis, with the additional style Gongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he was posthumously raised to first-rank marquis with the added epithet Respectful and Sincere.

sentences.zh: 子昂洪、多爾濟、綽爾濟、納穆生格、朗素。

translations.literal: His sons were Ang Hong, Duo'erji, Chuo'erji, Namushengge, and Langsu.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Ang Hong, Duo'erji, Chuo'erji, Namushengge, and Langsu.

sentences.zh: 昂洪初從父來歸，授游擊。

translations.literal: Ang Hong first came to submit with his father and was appointed yuji.
translations.idiomatic: Ang Hong had followed his father in submission and was appointed yuji.

sentences.zh: 天命十一年，從伐巴林、扎魯特諸部；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianming, he followed campaigns against the Balin, Zhalute, and other tribes;
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 11 he campaigned against the Balin, Zhalute, and other tribes;

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，從伐明，攻大凌河：俱有功，超進三等副將，賜號達爾漢和碩齊。

translations.literal: in the fifth year of Tiancong, he followed the campaign against Ming and attacked Dalinghe—all with merit—and was specially advanced to third-rank vice general, granted the title Daerhan heshuqi.
translations.idiomatic: and in Tiancong 5 joined the Ming campaign at Dalinghe. For these services he was promoted ahead of schedule to third-rank vice general and given the title Daerhan heshuqi.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 子鄂齊爾，襲。

translations.literal: His son Eqi'er succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Eqi'er inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 八年，改三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, his title was changed to third-rank meile zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made third-rank meile zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治間，三以恩詔進，再以罪降，定為二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi, he was advanced three times by grace edicts, then demoted twice for offenses, and finally fixed at second-rank ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi he rose three times on amnesty edicts, fell twice for misconduct, and was finally fixed at second-rank ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 洊擢內大臣，管鑾儀衛事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to grand minister of the interior and placed in charge of the imperial guard of honor.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to grand minister of the interior and put in charge of the imperial guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 尋授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he died and was given the posthumous title Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourteenth year and was posthumously titled Diligent and Respectful.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the enfeoffment was fixed as third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong the hereditary rank was fixed at third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 多爾濟亦從父來歸，授備禦，尚主為額駙。

translations.literal: Duo'erji also came to submit with his father, was appointed beiyu, and married an imperial princess, becoming an imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Duo'erji likewise submitted with his father, was made beiyu, and married a princess, becoming an imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 天命十一年，從伐扎魯特，有盜馬遁者，多爾濟逐得之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianming, he followed the campaign against the Zhalute; when someone stole a horse and fled, Duo'erji pursued and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 11, on campaign against the Zhalute, he chased down and caught a man who had stolen a horse and fled.

sentences.zh: 尋又從伐棟奎、克什克騰諸部，又從伐朝鮮，皆有功。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he again followed campaigns against the Dongkui, Keshiketeng, and other tribes, and again followed the campaign against Korea—all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He soon fought again against the Dongkui and Keshiketeng tribes and joined the Korean campaign, earning merit in each.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，始設六部，以多爾濟為刑部承政，專理蒙古事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong the Six Ministries were first established; Duo'erji was made chengzheng of the Ministry of Punishments, specializing in Mongol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Six Ministries were created in Tiancong 5, Duo'erji was appointed chengzheng of the Board of Punishments with charge of Mongol affairs.

sentences.zh: 六年，以直上前失儀，又奉命選獵戶不當，吏議奪世職，上宥之，罰白金百。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, for impropriety before the sovereign in attendance and for improper selection of hunters when ordered, officials proposed stripping his hereditary office; the sovereign pardoned him and fined him a hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was cited for breaches of court decorum and for mishandling a levy of hunters; though officials urged stripping his rank, the sovereign pardoned him with a fine of one hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，攻大同，上命多爾濟領中軍，圖魯什、烏拜分率左右軍，與明總兵曹文詔戰，大破之，逐至城下，獲馬百。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he followed the campaign against Ming and attacked Datong. The sovereign ordered Duo'erji to command the center army, while Turushi and Ubai respectively led the left and right armies. They fought the Ming commander-in-chief Cao Wenshao, routed him utterly, pursued to beneath the walls, and captured a hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the Ming campaign at Datong. Nurhaci put Duo'erji in command of the center, with Turushi and Ubai on the wings. They shattered Ming general Cao Wenshao, chased him to the city walls, and took a hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，授內大臣，預議政。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, he was appointed grand minister of the interior and participated in deliberations on government.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he became a grand minister of the interior with a seat in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 四年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗略錦州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in raiding Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined Prince Zheng Jirhala in a raid on Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，上伐明，駐軍松山、杏山間，命多爾濟與內大臣錫翰設伏高橋。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the sovereign campaigned against Ming and encamped between Songshan and Xingshan; he ordered Duo'erji and the grand minister Xihan to set an ambush at Gaoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, campaigning against the Ming between Songshan and Xingshan, the sovereign ordered Duo'erji and Grand Minister Xihan to lay an ambush at Gaoqiao.

sentences.zh: 明杏山兵千人，以糧不繼潛遁，伏發，敗之，逐至塔山，俘斬甚眾。

translations.literal: A thousand Ming troops from Xingshan, their grain supply cut off, slipped away in secret; the ambush was sprung, they were defeated, and pursuit continued to Tashan, with very many taken prisoner or slain.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand Ming troops from Xingshan, short of supplies, tried to slip away; the ambush struck, routing them, and the pursuit reached Tashan with heavy casualties and captures.

sentences.zh: 尋以圍松山時，明總兵曹變蛟夜犯御營，多爾濟不能禦，議罪，系三日，罰白金五百，仍敘高橋功，進一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, during the siege of Songshan, when the Ming commander Cao Bianjiao attacked the imperial camp by night, Duo'erji could not repel him; guilt was debated, he was detained three days and fined five hundred taels of silver, yet his merit at Gaoqiao was still recorded and he was advanced to first-rank meile zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Later, during the Songshan siege, when Ming general Cao Bianjiao raided the imperial camp by night, Duo'erji failed to drive him off. He was held three days and fined five hundred taels, but his Gaoqiao victory still counted, and he was promoted to first-rank meile zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，以多爾濟夙荷太宗恩厚，進三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, because Duo'erji had long enjoyed the Taizong's deep favor, he was advanced to third-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2, in recognition of long-standing favor from the Taizong, Duo'erji was raised to third-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 四年，改三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, his title was changed to third-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was redesignated third-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 弟綽爾濟，襲。

translations.literal: His younger brother Chuo'erji succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chuo'erji inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 坐事，削爵。

translations.literal: For an offense, his nobility was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped of his title for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 弟納穆生格，襲。

translations.literal: His younger brother Namushengge succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Namushengge inherited.

sentences.zh: 從征福建，沒於海，諡直勇。

translations.literal: He followed the Fujian campaign and perished at sea, receiving the posthumous title Zhiyong.
translations.idiomatic: On the Fujian campaign he was lost at sea and was posthumously titled Upright and Brave.

sentences.zh: 納穆生格既卒，復以綽爾濟襲。

translations.literal: After Namushengge died, Chuo'erji again succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Namushengge died, Chuo'erji resumed the inheritance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定三等子，多爾濟三世從孫博清額襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the rank was fixed as third-rank viscount, and Boqing'e, a third-generation collateral descendant of Duo'erji, succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong the line was fixed at third-rank viscount, inherited by Boqing'e, a third-generation descendant of Duo'erji's line.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，改襲一等恭誠侯，為其四世祖明安後。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, succession was changed to first-rank Marquis Gongcheng, as a descendant in the fourth generation from his fourth-generation ancestor Ming'an.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 the succession was shifted to first-rank Marquis Gongcheng, reverting to Ming'an's line four generations back.

sentences.zh: 朗素，明安幼子，襲明安世職。

translations.literal: Langsu, Ming'an's youngest son, inherited Ming'an's hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Langsu, Ming'an's youngest son, inherited his father's hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 傳至孫馬蘭泰，雍正七年，上以明安舊勞，進一等恭誠侯，命署前鋒統領。

translations.literal: The line passed to his grandson Malantai. In the seventh year of Yongzheng, because of Ming'an's old services, the sovereign advanced him to first-rank Marquis Gongcheng and ordered him to act as commander of the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: By his grandson Malantai's time, Yongzheng 7 saw him raised to first-rank Marquis Gongcheng for Ming'an's past service and appointed acting commander of the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 九年，討準噶爾，授參贊大臣，疏言寇犯西爾哈昭，擊之敗退，擢領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, campaigning against the Dzungars, he was appointed assistant grand minister; in a memorial he reported that bandits had invaded Xi'erhazhao, that he attacked and drove them back in defeat, and he was promoted to leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, on the Dzungar campaign as assistant grand minister, he reported repelling raiders at Xi'erhazhao and was promoted to leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 召還，命在辦理軍機處行走。

translations.literal: He was recalled and ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 俄，察知在軍恇怯，妄奏功，謫軍前自效，逮京論斬，繫獄。

translations.literal: Soon it was discovered that in the army he had been cowardly and had falsely reported merit; he was demoted to redeem himself at the front, then brought to the capital for sentencing to decapitation and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was found to have been timid in the field and to have claimed false victories; demoted to prove himself at the front, he was later brought to the capital for execution and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，复授副都統。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, he was again appointed vice commander of the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong he was again made vice commander of the garrison.

sentences.zh: 又以扈從行圍後至，稱疾不治事，發拉林披甲。

translations.literal: Again, for arriving late while escorting the hunting encampment, and for claiming illness and neglecting duties, he was sent to Lalin to serve as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: He was later banished to Lalin as a common soldier for arriving late on a hunting escort and feigning illness to avoid duty.

sentences.zh: 初，明安所與同部諸貝勒入朝請內附，皆授世職有差，鎖諾木子穆赫林自有傳。

translations.literal: Earlier, the beiles of Ming'an's tribe who had come to court to request submission were all granted hereditary offices in varying degrees; Suonuomu's son Muhelin has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming'an's fellow beiles had sought submission, each received a hereditary post of appropriate rank; Suonuomu's son Muhelin has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 又有恩格類、布當叔侄與明安同時來歸，布顏代歸稍後，皆從征伐有戰績。

translations.literal: There were also the uncle and nephew Enggelei and Budang, who submitted at the same time as Ming'an; Buyandai submitted somewhat later—all followed campaigns with battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: The uncle-nephew pair Enggelei and Budang submitted with Ming'an; Buyandai came somewhat later. All served on campaign with recorded victories.

sentences.zh: 恩格類、布當，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Enggelei and Budang were of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Enggelei and Budang belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 來歸，恩格類授游擊，布當授二等參將。

translations.literal: On submission, Enggelei was appointed yuji and Budang second-rank canjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On submitting, Enggelei was made yuji and Budang second-rank canjiang.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，太宗自將伐明，布當從攻遵化，與甲喇額真英俄爾岱合軍力戰，破明總兵趙率教，以功進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, the Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming; Budang followed in the attack on Zunhua, joined forces with the jiala ejen Ying'e'erdai, fought fiercely, defeated the Ming commander Zhao Shuaijiao, and for merit was advanced to third-rank meile zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 the Taizong led a Ming campaign in person; Budang helped take Zunhua, fighting alongside Jiala Ejen Ying'e'erdai to defeat Ming general Zhao Shuaijiao, and was promoted to third-rank meile zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 六年，散蒙古旗入滿洲，恩格類、布當皆隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the Mongol banner was dispersed into the Manchu banners, Enggelei and Budang were both attached to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Mongol banners were absorbed into Manchu ones, Enggelei and Budang were assigned to the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授布當刑部右參政。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, Budang was appointed right vice censor of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 Budang was made right vice censor of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year.

sentences.zh: 布當弟色棱，襲恩格類世職。

translations.literal: Budang's younger brother Seleng succeeded to Enggelei's hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Budang's younger brother Seleng inherited Enggelei's hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，伐明，克遵化，圍錦州。

translations.literal: Serving the Taizong, he campaigned against Ming, captured Zunhua, and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizong he fought the Ming, took Zunhua, and besieged Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 事世祖，從入關破賊，擊騰吉斯，並有功。

translations.literal: Serving the Shizu, he followed in entering the passes to defeat the rebels, attacked Tengjisi, and in all had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shizu he entered the passes, helped crush the rebels, fought Tengjisi, and earned merit throughout.

sentences.zh: 進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: He was advanced to first-rank adaha hafan with the additional title tuwashara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to first-rank adaha hafan with the added tuwashara hafan title.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 布顏代，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Buyandai was of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Buyandai belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 初為蒙古烏魯特貝子。

translations.literal: At first he was a Mongol Uruud beizi.
translations.idiomatic: He had originally been a Mongol Uruud beizi.

sentences.zh: 天命七年，籍所轄戶口自西拉塔喇來歸，尚主為額駙，予二等參將世職，隸滿洲鑲紅旗。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianming, registering the households under his jurisdiction, he came to submit from Xilatala, married an imperial princess and became an imperial son-in-law, was granted a second-rank canjiang hereditary office, and was attached to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 7 he brought his registered households from Xilatala to submit, married a princess, received a hereditary second-rank canjiang post, and was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，太祖自將伐明，攻寧遠，不克，偏師取覺華島，布顏代率蒙古兵從固山額真武訥格破敵壘，殲其眾，焚所積芻糧而還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Taizu personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Ningyuan without success; a detached force took Juehua Island. Buyandai led Mongol troops following the gushan ejen Wunage to break the enemy stockade, annihilate their forces, burn the fodder and grain they had stored, and return.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Nurhaci attacked Ningyuan without success while a flank force took Juehua Island. Buyandai led Mongols with Gushan Ejen Wunage, stormed the enemy fort, destroyed the garrison, burned their stores, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: =恩格德爾=恩格德爾，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Enggeder. Enggeder was of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Enggeder. Enggeder belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 其先世元裔，為蒙古喀爾喀巴約特部長。

translations.literal: His ancestors were Yuan imperial descendants and he was chief of the Mongol Khalkha Bayot tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His forebears were Yuan imperial kin, and he headed the Khalkha Bayot Mongols.

sentences.zh: 當太祖初起兵時，喀爾喀裂為五部，巴約特其一也，恩格德爾父達爾漢巴圖魯，為其部貝勒，牧地曰西喇木倫。

translations.literal: When the Taizu first raised his army, the Khalkha had split into five tribes, of which Bayot was one; Enggeder's father Daerhan batulu was beile of that tribe, with pastures at Xilamulun.
translations.idiomatic: When Nurhaci first took up arms, the Khalkha had divided into five tribes, Bayot among them. Enggeder's father Daerhan batulu was its beile, pasturing along the Xilamulun.

sentences.zh: 太祖起兵之十二年，歲甲午正月，喀爾喀部貝勒老薩、北科爾沁部貝勒明安始遣使​​來聘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year after the Taizu raised his army, in the first month of the jiawu year, the Khalkha beile Laosai and the North Khorchin beile Ming'an first sent envoys to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve years after Nurhaci's uprising, in the first month of jiawu, the Khalkha beile Laosai and the North Khorchin beile Ming'an sent their first embassies.

sentences.zh: 又十一年，歲乙巳，恩格德爾來謁，獻馬二十，上優賚而遣之。

translations.literal: Eleven years later, in the yisi year, Enggeder came to audience, presented twenty horses, and the sovereign richly rewarded him and sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven years on, in yisi, Enggeder paid court with twenty horses; the sovereign treated him generously and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 明年，歲丙午冬十二月，恩格德爾率五部諸貝勒之使謁太祖，獻駝馬，奉表上尊號曰神武皇帝。

translations.literal: The next year, in the twelfth month of winter in the bingwu year, Enggeder led envoys of the beiles of the five tribes to audience with the Taizu, presented camels and horses, and submitted a memorial offering the honorific title Divine Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The following winter, in the twelfth month of bingwu, Enggeder brought envoys of five tribes to Nurhaci with camels and horses and a memorial offering the title Divine Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 自此蒙古諸部朝貢歲至。

translations.literal: From this time Mongol tribes sent tribute annually.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Mongol tribes paid tribute every year.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，恩格德爾偕其妻郡主來朝，請率所部來歸，上嘉其誠，與之盟，賜以敕：「非叛逆，他罪皆得免。」

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, Enggeder came to court with his wife the commandery princess, requesting to lead his tribe to submit. The sovereign praised his sincerity, made a covenant with him, and granted an edict: "Except for rebellion, all other offenses may be pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year Enggeder came to court with his wife the commandery princess and asked to bring his people in. The sovereign commended his sincerity, swore an alliance, and granted an edict: "Save treason, all other crimes shall be forgiven."

sentences.zh: 命貝勒代善等帥師移所部至遼陽。

translations.literal: He ordered the beile Daishan and others to lead troops to move his tribe to Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Beile Daishan and others to escort the tribe to Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 既至，上郊勞，設宴章義站，賜恩格德爾及其弟莽果爾代雕鞍良馬一、貂裘一，恩格德爾子囊孥克、門都、答哈，莽果爾代子滿硃習禮猞狸猻裘一。

translations.literal: When they arrived, the sovereign welcomed them beyond the suburbs, held a banquet at Zhangyi Station, and granted Enggeder and his younger brother Mangguo'erdai each one carved-saddle fine horse and one sable robe; to Enggeder's sons Nangnuke, Mendu, and Daha, and Mangguo'erdai's son Manzhu, he granted one lynx-fur robe each for learning ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On their arrival Nurhaci met them outside the city and feasted them at Zhangyi Station. Enggeder and his brother Mangguo'erdai each received a fine horse with carved saddle and a sable coat; Enggeder's sons Nangnuke, Mendu, and Daha, and Mangguo'erdai's son Manzhu each received a lynx-fur robe for court study.

sentences.zh: 既入城，賜田宅、金銀、貂、猞狸猻、段疋、器用及耕作之具，復分平定堡民屬焉。

translations.literal: After entering the city, he granted fields and houses, gold and silver, sable and lynx furs, bolts of silk, utensils, and farming tools, and again allotted to them the people of Pingdingbao.
translations.idiomatic: Once in the city they received land, houses, gold and silver, furs, silks, utensils, and farm tools, along with households from Pingdingbao.

sentences.zh: 尋授恩格德爾、莽果爾代三等總兵官。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Enggeder and Mangguo'erdai were appointed third-rank zongbingguan.
translations.idiomatic: Enggeder and Mangguo'erdai were soon made third-rank zongbingguan.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was fixed, they were attached to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When banners were regularized they were assigned to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，與武訥格等帥師伐察哈爾，降二千戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, together with Wunage and others he led troops against the Chakhar and received the surrender of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he joined Wunage in an expedition against the Chakhar, bringing two thousand households to surrender.

sentences.zh: 語詳武訥格傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in detail in the biography of Wunage.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign is narrated fully in Wunage's biography.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，從上伐明，入龍井關，克遵化，薄明都，上駐軍德勝門外。

translations.literal: That winter, he followed the sovereign in campaigning against Ming, entered Longjing Pass, captured Zunhua, pressed close to the Ming capital, and the sovereign encamped outside Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he joined the Ming campaign, passed Longjing Pass, took Zunhua, and approached the capital while the sovereign camped outside Desheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 明督師袁崇煥率總兵祖大壽軍二萬人，自寧遠赴援，屯城東南。

translations.literal: The Ming supreme commander Yuan Chonghuan led the commander Zu Dashou with twenty thousand troops from Ningyuan to relieve the city and encamped southeast of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ming supreme commander Yuan Chonghuan marched from Ningyuan with general Zu Dashou and twenty thousand men, encamping southeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 上令諸軍進戰，時恩格德爾與武訥格共將蒙古兵。

translations.literal: The sovereign ordered the armies to advance to battle; at that time Enggeder and Wunage jointly commanded the Mongol troops.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign ordered a general attack; Enggeder and Wunage jointly led the Mongol contingent.

sentences.zh: 恩格德爾率左翼，未成列，縱騎驟進，為所敗，卻走；

translations.literal: Enggeder led the left wing; before the line was formed, he let the cavalry charge forward suddenly, was defeated by the enemy, and fell back;
translations.idiomatic: Enggeder commanded the left wing; before his line had formed he sent cavalry charging ahead, was beaten back, and retreated;

sentences.zh: 武訥格以右翼突擊，乃敗敵。

translations.literal: Wunage with the right wing made a sudden attack and then defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Wunage's right wing then struck hard and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 吏議恩格德爾當奪世職，上命貸之。

translations.literal: Officials proposed that Enggeder's hereditary office should be stripped; the sovereign ordered it remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials urged stripping Enggeder's hereditary rank; the sovereign pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 四年春，克永平。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Yongping was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year they took Yongping.

sentences.zh: 恩格德爾行略地，遇明將將步卒三百，將戰；

translations.literal: Enggeder was raiding the countryside; he encountered a Ming general leading three hundred infantry and was about to give battle;
translations.idiomatic: While Enggeder was foraging the countryside, he met a Ming general with three hundred foot soldiers and prepared to fight;

sentences.zh: 復有騎兵三千自玉田城突出，恩格德爾陽退誘敵，敵稍前，疑有伏，還走；

translations.literal: Again three thousand cavalry sallied from Yutian city; Enggeder feigned retreat to lure the enemy; the enemy advanced slightly, suspected an ambush, and turned back to flee;
translations.idiomatic: Then three thousand horsemen burst out of Yutian; Enggeder pretended to withdraw to bait them forward. When they advanced a little, they feared an ambush and wheeled about to flee;

sentences.zh: 因追躡其後，獲馬百。

translations.literal: He therefore pursued close on their heels and captured a hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: He then chased them down and seized a hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍大凌河城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he followed in besieging Dalinghe city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 明監軍道張春、總兵吳襄等軍四萬自錦州赴援，上親督諸軍擊破之。

translations.literal: The Ming military inspector Zhang Chun, commander Wu Xiang, and others with forty thousand troops came from Jinzhou to relieve the city; the sovereign personally directed the armies and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Ming inspector Zhang Chun and commander Wu Xiang marched forty thousand men from Jinzhou to the relief; the sovereign personally led the armies and broke them.

sentences.zh: 初戰，敵甚銳，蒙古兵右翼猛進，先入張春壘；

translations.literal: At the first clash the enemy was very fierce; the Mongol troops' right wing charged hard and first entered Zhang Chun's camp;
translations.idiomatic: In the opening fight the enemy pressed hard; the Mongol right wing stormed forward and was first into Zhang Chun's lines;

sentences.zh: 左翼兵避矢石，進稍緩。

translations.literal: The left-wing troops avoided arrows and stones and advanced rather slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing hung back from arrows and stones and moved up more slowly.

sentences.zh: 吏議恩格德爾當奪世職，上復命貸之，罰鞍馬一、白金百。

translations.literal: Officials proposed that Enggeder's hereditary office should be stripped; the sovereign again ordered it remitted and fined him one saddle-horse and a hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Officials again urged stripping Enggeder's hereditary rank; the sovereign once more pardoned him but fined him one saddle horse and a hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年五月，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Chongde, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth month of Chongde 1.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，追諡端順，立碑紀功。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi, he was posthumously given the temple name Duanshun and a stele was erected to record his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 he was posthumously titled Duanshun, and a stele was raised to commemorate his service.

sentences.zh: 子額爾克戴青，初任侍衛，授三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: His son Erke Daiqing first served as a guardsman and was granted third-rank jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: His son Erke Daiqing began as a guardsman and received third-rank jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 恩格德爾既卒，以額爾克戴青襲父爵，而以所授世職予其弟索爾噶。

translations.literal: After Enggeder died, Erke Daiqing inherited his father's nobility, while the hereditary office he had been granted was given to his younger brother Sorha.
translations.idiomatic: When Enggeder died, Erke Daiqing succeeded to his father's title, and the hereditary office Erke Daiqing held went to his brother Sorha.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，進二等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, he was advanced to second-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 he was raised to second-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，遇恩詔，進三等侯。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, upon a grace edict, he was advanced to third-rank marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year a grace edict promoted him to third-rank marquis.

sentences.zh: 大學士剛林、祁充格等諷使附睿親王多爾袞，當改入正白旗，額爾克戴青不從，旋構吏議，降二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Grand secretaries Ganglin, Qi Chongge, and others insinuated that he should attach himself to Prince Regent Dorgon and transfer to the Plain White Banner; Erke Daiqing refused, and soon officials fabricated charges against him, reducing him to second-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries Ganglin and Qi Chongge hinted that he should align with Prince Regent Dorgon and move to the Plain White Banner. Erke Daiqing refused; officials soon manufactured a case against him and demoted him to second-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 世祖親政，嘉其持正無所阿，復進一等侯，列議政大臣，管鑾儀衛，擢領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: When the Shizu took personal rule, he commended Erke Daiqing's upright refusal to curry favor, restored him to first-rank marquis, made him a deliberative minister, put him in charge of the imperial guard of honor, and promoted him to leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizu assumed personal rule, he praised Erke Daiqing's steadfast refusal to truckle, restored him to first-rank marquis, made him a deliberative minister, placed him over the imperial guard of honor, and promoted him to leading grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 再遇恩詔，又以索爾噶卒，仍兼三等甲喇章京，三進至一等公。

translations.literal: Upon another grace edict, and because Sorha had died, he still held third-rank jalan zhangjing as well, and after three advancements reached first-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: On a further grace edict, and with Sorha's death leaving third-rank jalan zhangjing vacant, he held both offices and rose through three steps to first-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐讞獄有所徇，降二等公。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, for partiality in trying a case, he was reduced to second-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he showed favoritism in a trial and was demoted to second-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 十四年，加少保，兼太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he was given the additional ranks of Junior Guardian and Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he received the additional titles of Junior Guardian and Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年，額爾克戴青僕毆侍衛於市，先發誣侍衛；

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Erke Daiqing's servant beat a guardsman in the market and first lodged a false accusation against the guardsman;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Erke Daiqing's servant assaulted a guardsman in the marketplace and then preemptively slandered the guardsman;

sentences.zh: 讞實，額爾克戴青坐徇縱，削爵奪官，留內大臣銜。

translations.literal: When the case was verified, Erke Daiqing was found guilty of favoritism and indulgence; his title and office were stripped, though he retained the rank of grand minister of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Once the facts were established, Erke Daiqing was judged guilty of shielding his man; his title and post were removed, though he kept grand minister of the interior rank.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月，卒，諡勤良。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year he died; posthumous name Qinliang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth month of the eighteenth year and was posthumously titled Qinliang.

sentences.zh: 恩格德爾初封，是時從例改三等昂邦章京，其長子囊弩克當襲。

translations.literal: At Enggeder's initial enfeoffment, his title was then changed according to precedent to third-rank angbang zhangjing; his eldest son Nangnuke was to inherit it.
translations.idiomatic: At Enggeder's first enfeoffment the title was then changed by precedent to third-rank angbang zhangjing, with his eldest son Nangnuke to inherit.

sentences.zh: 囊弩克先以從軍授二等甲喇章京，合為二等伯。

translations.literal: Nangnuke had earlier been granted second-rank jalan zhangjing for military service; combined with the inheritance, this made second-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: Nangnuke had already earned second-rank jalan zhangjing in the field; together with the inheritance this amounted to second-rank count.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，復為二等公，降襲一等侯。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign it became second-rank duke again, with succession at first-rank marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi it reverted to second-rank duke, with heirs succeeding at first-rank marquis.

sentences.zh: 世宗時，特命襲三等公，加封號順義，旋改奉義。

translations.literal: In the Shizong reign he was specially ordered to inherit as third-rank duke, with the added style Shunyi, soon changed to Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shizong he was specially commanded to inherit as third-rank duke with the style Shunyi, soon changed to Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，定封一等奉義侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, the fixed enfeoffment was first-rank Marquis of Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9 the permanent title was fixed as first-rank Marquis of Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 莽果爾代初與恩格德爾同授三等總兵官，改三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: Mangguo'erdai had initially received third-rank zongbingguan together with Enggeder, later changed to third-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Mangguo'erdai had first received third-rank zongbingguan together with Enggeder, then been redesignated third-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破流賊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, he followed in entering the pass and defeated the bandit rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he crossed the pass with the armies and helped crush the rebel bands.

sentences.zh: 三遇恩詔，進一等伯。

translations.literal: On three grace edicts he was advanced to first-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: Three grace edicts raised him to first-rank count.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，降襲二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, succession was at second-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng heirs succeeded at second-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the fixed enfeoffment was first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Qianlong the permanent rank was fixed as first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: =古爾布什=古爾布什，亦元裔，為喀爾喀台吉，與恩格德爾同牧西喇木倫。

translations.literal: Gurushi. Gurushi was also a Yuan descendant, a Khalkha taiji who pastured alongside Enggeder at Xilamulun.
translations.idiomatic: Gurushi. Gurushi too was of Yuan imperial descent, a Khalkha taiji who grazed his herds with Enggeder along the Xilamulun.

sentences.zh: 十一月，偕台吉莽果爾，率所屬六百戶，驅牲畜來歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, together with taiji Mangguo'er, he led six hundred households under his command, driving livestock to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he came in with taiji Mangguo'er, bringing six hundred households and their herds to submit.

sentences.zh: 太祖御殿，入謁與宴，各賜裘：貂三，猞猁猻、虎、貉皆二，狐一；

translations.literal: The Taizu took the throne hall; they entered to pay homage and were feasted; each was granted furs: three sables, two each of lynx, tiger, and raccoon-dog, and one fox;
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu received them in the throne hall; they paid homage and were banqueted. Each received furs: three sables; two each of lynx, tiger, and raccoon-dog; and one fox;

sentences.zh: 緣貂朝衣五，緣獺裘二，緣青鼠裘三，蟒衣九，蟒緞六，緞三十五，布五百，黃金十兩，白金五百兩，雕鞍一，鯊鞍七，玲瓏撒袋一，撒袋實弓矢八，甲胄十，僮僕、牛馬、田宅、雜具畢備。

translations.literal: five sable-trimmed court robes, two otter-trimmed coats, three squirrel-trimmed coats, nine python-pattern robes, six python brocades, thirty-five bolts of brocade, five hundred bolts of cloth, ten taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, one carved saddle, seven sharkskin saddles, one ornamental quiver, eight quivers filled with bow and arrows, ten suits of armor; retainers, cattle and horses, fields and houses, and miscellaneous implements were all fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: They also received five sable-trimmed court robes, two otter-trimmed coats, three squirrel-trimmed coats, nine python robes, six python brocades, thirty-five bolts of silk, five hundred bolts of cloth, ten taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, one carved saddle, seven sharkskin saddles, one ornamental quiver, eight quivers with bow and arrows, and ten suits of armor, along with retainers, livestock, land, houses, and every sort of household provision.

sentences.zh: 上以女妻古爾布什為額駙，賜名青卓禮克圖，畀滿洲、蒙古牛錄各一，授一等總兵世職，隸滿洲鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: The sovereign gave his daughter in marriage to Gurushi as imperial son-in-law, granted the name Qingzhuoleketu, allotted one Manchu and one Mongol niru each, conferred first-rank hereditary zongbingguan, and attached him to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign gave Gurushi his daughter as imperial son-in-law, bestowed the name Qingzhuoleketu, granted one Manchu and one Mongol niru, conferred first-rank hereditary zongbingguan, and enrolled him in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 古爾布什屢坐事論罰，至是以元妃喪，輔國公扎喀納軍中歌舞，吏議古爾布什不呵禁，不舉劾，當奪世職、籍沒，上复特貰之。

translations.literal: Gurushi was repeatedly punished for offenses; on this occasion, during mourning for the primary consort, Assistant Prince Zhakana sang and danced in the army; officials proposed that Gurushi, for failing to rebuke and stop this and for failing to impeach, should lose his hereditary office and have his property confiscated; the sovereign again specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Gurushi had been punished repeatedly for misconduct. Now, during mourning for the primary consort, Assistant Prince Zhakana sang and danced in camp. Officials argued that Gurushi should lose his hereditary rank and have his property seized for failing to stop or impeach him; the sovereign again granted a special pardon.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破流賊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, he followed in entering the pass and defeated the bandit rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he entered the pass with the armies and helped defeat the rebel bands.

sentences.zh: 复遇恩詔，累進一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Again upon grace edicts he was successively advanced to first-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Further grace edicts successively raised him to first-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，卒，諡敏襄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year he died; posthumous name Minxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first month of the eighteenth year and was posthumously titled Minxiang.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，降襲二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: During Kangxi, succession was at second-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi heirs succeeded at second-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，定封二等子。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, the fixed enfeoffment was second-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8 the permanent title was fixed as second-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 莽果爾與古爾布什偕來，同被賞賚。

translations.literal: Mangguo'er came together with Gurushi and received the same rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Mangguo'er arrived with Gurushi and received the same gifts.

sentences.zh: 太祖以族弟濟白里女妻焉，亦授總兵。

translations.literal: The Taizu gave him in marriage the daughter of his clansman younger brother Jibaili and also granted him zongbingguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu married him to the daughter of his clansman Jibaili and also made him zongbingguan.

sentences.zh: =鄂齊爾桑=鄂齊爾桑，博爾濟吉特氏，蒙古扎魯特部人。

translations.literal: Ochirsang. Ochirsang was of the Borjigit clan, a man of the Jarud tribe in Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: Ochirsang. Ochirsang belonged to the Borjigit clan and came from the Jarud Mongols.

sentences.zh: 父巴克，為其部貝勒。

translations.literal: His father Bark was beile of that tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bark was beile of the tribe.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，太祖既擊敗楊鎬，取開原；

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming, after the Taizu had defeated Yang Hao and taken Kaiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4, after the Taizu had routed Yang Hao and taken Kaiyuan;

sentences.zh: 七月，复克鐵嶺，即夕，巴克與喀爾喀部貝勒介賽等將萬餘人赴援，翌旦遂戰，諸部師大敗，獲介賽等及巴克以歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Tieling was again captured; that same evening Bark, Khalkha beile Jiesai, and others led more than ten thousand men to relieve the city; at dawn the next day battle was joined; the allied armies were utterly defeated, and Jiesai, Bark, and others were captured and brought back.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tieling fell again. That very evening Bark, the Khalkha beile Jiesai, and others marched more than ten thousand men to its relief. Battle was joined at dawn; the allied force was shattered, and Jiesai, Bark, and the rest were taken back in captivity.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，鄂齊爾桑入質，請釋巴克，上許之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, Ochirsang came as a hostage and requested Bark's release; the sovereign granted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year Ochirsang came as a hostage and asked for Bark's release; the sovereign agreed.

sentences.zh: 八年，巴克朝正旦，上悅，遣鄂齊爾桑與俱還。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Bark came to court on New Year's Day; the sovereign was pleased and sent Ochirsang back with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Bark paid New Year's court; pleased, the sovereign sent Ochirsang home with him.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，以扎魯特部敗盟，貳於明，命貝勒代善、阿敏等將萬人討之，斬倡叛者貝勒吳爾寨圖，獲巴克及其二子，諸貝勒喇什希布、代青、桑噶爾寨等十四人以歸。

translations.literal: When the Taizong ascended, because the Jarud tribe had broken the covenant and sided with Ming, he ordered beiles Daishan, Amin, and others to lead ten thousand men against them; they beheaded the ringleader beile Wuerzhaitu, captured Bark and his two sons, and brought back fourteen men including beiles Lashe xibu, Daichin, and Sangaerzhai.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizong took the throne, the Jarud broke their oath and turned to Ming. He sent beiles Daishan and Amin with ten thousand men against them. They beheaded the rebel beile Wuerzhaitu, captured Bark and his two sons, and brought back fourteen beiles including Lashe xibu, Daichin, and Sangaerzhai.

sentences.zh: 上命隸滿洲鑲黃旗，賜衣服器用。

translations.literal: The sovereign ordered them attached to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and granted clothes and implements.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign enrolled them in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and gave them clothing and equipment.

sentences.zh: 尋授鄂齊爾桑牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Ochirsang was made niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Ochirsang was soon appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，諸博爾濟吉特之裔來歸，為將有戰功受封爵者，又有布爾喀圖、弼喇什、色爾格克。

translations.literal: In the Taizong's time, among Borjigit descendants who came to submit, served as generals, won battle honors, and received enfeoffment, there were also Bulkitu, Bilashi, and Se'ergeke.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizong's day, among Borjigit descendants who submitted, took command, won honors, and received titles, there were also Bulkitu, Bilashi, and Se'ergeke.

sentences.zh: 布爾喀圖，初為喀喇沁部台吉。

translations.literal: Bulkitu was initially a taiji of the Khorchin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Bulkitu was originally a taiji of the Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 六月，使入貢，九月，來朝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he sent tribute; in the ninth month he came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he sent tribute; in the ninth he came to court.

sentences.zh: 十月，太宗自將伐明，以布爾喀圖嘗如明朝貢，習知關隘，使為導。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming; because Bulkitu had once gone to Ming to pay tribute and was familiar with passes and forts, he was made guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Taizong led a campaign against Ming himself. Because Bulkitu had once paid tribute to Ming and knew the passes, he was made guide.

sentences.zh: 師入邊，克龍井關，撫定羅文峪，分兵命布爾喀圖戍焉。

translations.literal: The army entered the frontier, captured Longjing Pass, pacified Luowenyu, and detached troops ordering Bulkitu to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: The army crossed the border, took Longjing Pass, pacified Luowenyu, and left Bulkitu with a detachment to hold the place.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，明將丁啟明等以三千人來攻，布爾喀圖與戰，明兵敗，入堡。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Ming generals Ding Qiming and others came with three thousand men to attack; Bulkitu fought them; the Ming troops were defeated and entered the fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year Ming generals Ding Qiming and others attacked with three thousand men. Bulkitu met them in battle; the Ming force was beaten back into the fort.

sentences.zh: 翌日進兵，克其堡，獲啟明及裨將三，俘馘甚眾，賜號岱達爾漢。

translations.literal: The next day he advanced, captured the fort, took Qiming and three subordinate generals, killed and captured many, and was granted the style Daidarhan.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he pressed the attack, took the fort, captured Qiming and three subordinate generals, and killed or captured a great number. He was granted the style Daidarhan.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，以貝勒阿巴泰第四女妻焉。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, the fourth daughter of beile Abatai was given to him in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year he was given Beile Abatai's fourth daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 三月，從上伐察哈爾。

translations.literal: In the third month, he followed the sovereign in campaigning against the Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he joined the sovereign's campaign against the Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾部眾有降而復叛者，劫軍中土默特部人畜，布爾喀圖追擊，斬逋者，足被創，尋挈所部來歸。

translations.literal: Among the Chakhar tribesmen, some who had surrendered rebelled again and looted people and livestock of the Tumet tribe in the army; Bulkitu pursued, beheaded fugitives, was wounded in the foot, and soon led his following back.
translations.idiomatic: Some Chakhar who had surrendered rebelled again and plundered Tumet people and livestock in the army camp. Bulkitu pursued, killed fugitives, was wounded in the foot, and soon brought his following back in.

sentences.zh: 蒙古旗制定，隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: When the Mongol banners were fixed, he was attached to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banners were organized he was assigned to the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年六月，授一等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Chongde, he was granted first-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Chongde 1 he received first-rank angbang zhangjing.

translations.literal: , he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子班珠勒，襲。

translations.literal: His son Banzhule succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Banzhule inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 恩詔累進一等伯。

translations.literal: Grace edicts successively advanced him to first-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: Grace edicts successively raised the line to first-rank count.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the fixed enfeoffment was first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Qianlong the permanent title was fixed as first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 弼喇什，亦喀喇沁部台吉。

translations.literal: Bilashi was also a taiji of the Khorchin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Bilashi too was a taiji of the Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 二月，從其父貝勒布延謁太宗，請歸附。

translations.literal: In the second month, together with his father beile Buyan he had audience with the Taizong and requested to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he and his father Beile Buyan had audience with the Taizong and asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 八月，上自將伐察哈爾，徵蒙古諸部兵，次綽洛郭​​爾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the sovereign personally led a campaign against the Chakhar, summoned troops from the Mongol tribes, and halted at Chuoluoguo'er.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the sovereign led a campaign against the Chakhar in person, called up Mongol levies, and encamped at Chuoluoguo'er.

sentences.zh: 弼喇什從其汗拉斯喀布謁行在，獻財幣駝馬，上悉卻之，賜宴，與以甲胄，遂從上擊察哈爾，戰有功。

translations.literal: Bilashi followed his khan Lasikabu to audience at the imperial camp, presented treasure, camels, and horses; the sovereign refused them all, granted a banquet, gave him armor, and then followed the sovereign in attacking the Chakhar, performing merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Bilashi followed his khan Lasikabu to the imperial camp and offered treasure, camels, and horses. The sovereign declined them all, feasted him, gave him armor, and then took him against the Chakhar, where he fought with distinction.

sentences.zh: 旋又從貝勒岳託伐棟奎部，與甲喇額真薩木什喀、牛錄額真布顏、巴牙喇壯達博爾輝等同力戰破敵，斬百餘人。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he again followed beile Yueto in campaigning against the Dongkui tribe; together with jalan ejen Samushka, niru ejen Buyan, bayara janggin Bo'erhui, and others he fought with combined force, broke the enemy, and beheaded more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Beile Yueto against the Dongkui, and with jalan ejen Samushka, niru ejen Buyan, bayara janggin Bo'erhui, and others fought shoulder to shoulder, broke the enemy, and took more than a hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 尋率所屬人戶來歸。

translations.literal: Soon he led the households under his command to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He soon brought the households under his command in to submit.

sentences.zh: 蒙古旗制定，隸鑲紅旗。

translations.literal: When the Mongol banners were fixed, he was attached to the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banners were organized he was assigned to the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 上妻以宗女，命貝勒代善贍焉。

translations.literal: The sovereign gave him an imperial clanswoman in marriage and ordered beile Daishan to provide for him.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign gave him an imperial clanswoman in marriage and ordered Beile Daishan to support him.

sentences.zh: 弼喇什自陳貧乏，上賜以金。

translations.literal: Bilashi himself stated that he was poor; the sovereign granted him gold.
translations.idiomatic: Bilashi pleaded poverty, and the sovereign gave him gold.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，授世職三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he was granted the hereditary third-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he received hereditary third-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，與明通市張家口，命弼喇什蒞焉。

translations.literal: In the third year, when trade was opened with Ming at Zhangjiakou, Bilashi was ordered to attend.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when trade with Ming opened at Zhangjiakou, Bilashi was sent to oversee it.

sentences.zh: 六年，復往蒞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he went again to attend.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he went again to oversee the market.

sentences.zh: 時諸王大臣各遣其屬從，有盜禮親王代善金者，弼喇什坐失囚，論罰。

translations.literal: At that time each prince and minister sent subordinates to accompany him; someone stole Prince Li Daishan's gold; Bilashi was punished for allowing a prisoner to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Each prince and minister then sent retainers with him. When someone stole Prince Li Daishan's gold, Bilashi was fined for letting a prisoner escape.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，從豫親王多鐸逐騰機思，道卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, he followed Prince Yu Dodo in pursuing Tengjisi and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 he followed Prince Yu Dodo in the pursuit of Tengjisi and died on the march.

sentences.zh: 子多爾濟，襲。

translations.literal: His son Duo'erji succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Duo'erji inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 改三等精奇尼哈番，恩詔進二等。

translations.literal: The title was changed to third-rank jingqini hafan; grace edicts advanced it to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The title was changed to third-rank jingqini hafan, and grace edicts raised it to second rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, the fixed enfeoffment was third-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Qianlong the permanent title was fixed as third-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 色爾格克，先世居喀喇徹哩克部。

translations.literal: Se'ergeke's ancestors lived in the Khara Cherik tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Se'ergeke's forebears came from the Khara Cherik tribe.

sentences.zh: 父阿拜岱巴圖魯，天聰間率眾來歸，授世職三等甲喇章京，隸正白旗。

translations.literal: His father Abaidai batulu led his following to submit during Tiancong, was granted hereditary third-rank jalan zhangjing, and was attached to the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Abaidai batulu brought his people in during Tiancong, received hereditary third-rank jalan zhangjing, and was enrolled in the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒，以色爾格克襲，授一等侍衛。

translations.literal: When he died, Se'ergeke succeeded and was granted first-rank guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, Se'ergeke succeeded and was made first-rank guardsman.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he followed in the campaign against Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the campaign against Korea.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李倧保南漢山城，師從之，色爾格克登山，身被創，賚馬三。

translations.literal: The king of Korea, Li Juan, held Namhansanseong; the army followed him there; Se'ergeke climbed the mountain, was wounded, and was rewarded with three horses.
translations.idiomatic: King Li Juan of Korea held Namhansanseong, and the army followed him there. Se'ergeke scaled the heights, was wounded, and received three horses as reward.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗等伐明，圍錦州，色爾格克率侍衛二十人前搏戰。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others in campaigning against Ming and besieging Jinzhou; Se'ergeke led twenty guardsmen forward in close combat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others against Ming in the siege of Jinzhou. Se'ergeke led twenty guardsmen forward into hand-to-hand fighting.

sentences.zh: 有僧格依者，自蒙古降明，為將，善戰，色爾格克擊斬之。

translations.literal: There was one Senggeyi, who had defected from Mongolia to Ming and served as a general, skilled in battle; Se'ergeke attacked and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: One Senggeyi, a Mongol who had gone over to Ming and become a capable general, was attacked and killed by Se'ergeke.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王使啟心郎額爾赫圖還，上其功。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng sent the qixinlang Erhetu back to report his merit to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng sent qixinlang Erhetu back to report his exploit to the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，令色爾格克選巴牙喇兵四十為伏以待敵，得明將一，奪甲與械，即以賜之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Jinzhou was again besieged; Se'ergeke was ordered to select forty bayara troops as ambush to await the enemy; he captured one Ming general, seized his armor and weapons, and these were granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Jinzhou was besieged again. Se'ergeke was told to pick forty bayara troops for an ambush; he captured a Ming general, took his armor and weapons, and was granted them.

sentences.zh: 上自將禦洪承疇，命諸將設伏高橋，色爾格克斬明兵七，复賚馬二。

translations.literal: The sovereign personally commanded against Hong Chengchou and ordered the generals to set an ambush at Gaoqiao; Se'ergeke beheaded seven Ming soldiers and was again rewarded with two horses.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign commanded in person against Hong Chengchou and ordered an ambush at Gaoqiao. Se'ergeke killed seven Ming soldiers and was again rewarded with two horses.

sentences.zh: 又先眾破敵騎。

translations.literal: Again he broke the enemy cavalry ahead of the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Again he routed the enemy cavalry ahead of the main force.

sentences.zh: 師圍松山，為壕環其城，城兵出擊烏真超哈分守地，色爾格克以巴牙喇兵三十人赴援，城兵引退。

translations.literal: The army besieged Songshan and dug trenches encircling the city; city troops sallied against the ujen cahaa detached garrison; Se'ergeke went with thirty bayara troops to relieve them, and the city troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The army besieged Songshan and ringed the city with trenches. When the garrison sallied against the ujen cahaa outpost, Se'ergeke rushed thirty bayara troops to its relief and the city force withdrew.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，越明都攻臨城；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, winter, he followed Beile Abatai in campaigning against Ming, passed the Ming capital, and attacked Lincheng;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, winter, he followed Beile Abatai against Ming, passed by the Ming capital, and attacked Lincheng;

sentences.zh: 略山東，攻青州，皆力戰，被創。

translations.literal: He raided Shandong and attacked Qingzhou; in all he fought fiercely and was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Shandong and assaulted Qingzhou, fighting hard throughout and taking wounds.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，錄阿拜岱巴圖魯舊勳及色爾格克戰功，复遇恩詔，授二等阿思哈尼哈番，擢內大臣。

translations.literal: When the Shizu acceded, Abaidai batulu's old merit and Se'ergeke's battle achievements were recorded; he again encountered a grace edict, was granted second-rank ashan i hafan, and was promoted to inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizu came to the throne, Abaidai batulu's old services and Se'ergeke's battlefield record were entered on the rolls. On a further grace edict he received second-rank ashan i hafan and was made inner minister.

sentences.zh: ，聖祖加恩諸舊臣，色爾格克加太子少保。

translations.literal: , the Sage Ancestor showed favor to the old ministers; Se'ergeke was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The Sage Ancestor then extended favor to the old ministers, and Se'ergeke was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒，諡勤敏。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died; his posthumous title was Qinmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twentieth year and was posthumously titled Qinmin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: In early Qianlong his enfeoffment was fixed at second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong his rank was fixed as second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =阿濟拜=阿濟拜，卓特氏，先世為蒙古巴林部人。

translations.literal: Aji Bai. Aji Bai was of the Jote clan; his forebears were men of the Barin tribe in Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Bai. Aji Bai belonged to the Jote clan; his ancestors came from the Barin Mongols.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was fixed, he was attached to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banners were organized, he was enrolled in the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初事太祖，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: He first served the Taizu and was granted niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Taizu's service early and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: ，太祖克撫順。

translations.literal: , the Taizu captured Fushun.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu took Fushun,

sentences.zh: 師還，明總兵張承廕自廣寧襲師後，阿濟拜從貝勒阿巴泰還擊，破之。

translations.literal: The army returned; Ming commander-in-chief Zhang Chengyin from Guangning attacked the rear of the army; Aji Bai followed Beile Abatai in a counterattack and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home, Ming commander-in-chief Zhang Chengyin sallied from Guangning against the rear. Aji Bai followed Beile Abatai in a counterstroke and routed him.

sentences.zh: 四年，破明總兵杜松於界凡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he defeated Ming commander-in-chief Du Song at Jiefan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he defeated Ming commander Du Song at Jiefan.

sentences.zh: 七年，敗明兵於沙嶺。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he defeated Ming troops at Shaling.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he routed Ming forces at Shaling.

sentences.zh: 阿濟拜皆在行間。

translations.literal: Aji Bai was present in all these campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Bai took part in every one of these actions.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass and attacked Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Shunzhi he crossed into China and fought Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 阿濟拜署梅勒額真，為後隊。

translations.literal: Aji Bai served as acting meiren ejen and commanded the rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Bai acted as meiren ejen and brought up the rear.

sentences.zh: 尋與固山額真伊拜逐寇山西，至澤州，數破賊壘，擢正藍旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, with gusa ejen Ibay he pursued the bandits in Shanxi as far as Zezhou, repeatedly broke their fortifications, and was promoted to Plain Blue Banner Mongol meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined gusa ejen Ibay in driving the rebels through Shanxi to Zezhou, storming their strongpoints again and again, and was raised to Plain Blue Banner Mongol meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 二年，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the second year he was granted half a rank step.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he received half a rank step.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，道漢中，與固山額真巴哈納擊走叛將賀珍；

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Hooge in suppressing Zhang Xianzhong; by way of Hanzhong, together with gusa ejen Bahana he routed the rebel general He Zhen;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Hooge against Zhang Xianzhong. Marching through Hanzhong, he and gusa ejen Bahana drove off the rebel general He Zhen;

sentences.zh: 徇秦州，與尚書星訥擊敗獻忠將高汝礪，獲馬騾百餘；

translations.literal: He subdued Qinzhou; together with Minister Xingne he defeated Zhang Xianzhong's general Gao Ruli and captured more than a hundred horses and mules;
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Qinzhou and, with Minister Xingne, broke Zhang Xianzhong's general Gao Ruli, seizing more than a hundred horses and mules;

sentences.zh: 進擊獻忠於西充，與巴牙喇纛額真阿爾津、蘇拜連戰皆捷。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Xianzhong at Xichong; with bayara dao ejen Erjin and Subai he fought in succession and won every engagement.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing Xianzhong at Xichong, he and bayara dao ejen Erjin and Subai fought battle after battle, each ending in victory.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，累進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded he encountered a grace edict and was cumulatively advanced to first-rank adaha hafan with tuwashara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the muster of honors, a grace edict raised him cumulatively to first-rank adaha hafan with tuwashara hafan.

sentences.zh: 九年八月，以老乞休，命解梅勒額真任。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the ninth year, citing age he requested retirement; he was ordered relieved of the meiren ejen post.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the ninth year he asked to retire on account of age and was released from the meiren ejen office.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，諡忠勤。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died; his posthumous title was Zhongqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after and was posthumously titled Zhongqin.

sentences.zh: =恩格圖=恩格圖，失其氏，蒙古科爾沁部人。

translations.literal: Enggtu. Enggtu—his clan is lost—was a man of the Khorchin Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Enggtu. Enggtu's clan is no longer known; he came from the Khorchin Mongols.

sentences.zh: 自哈達挈家來歸，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: From Hada he brought his household to submit and was granted niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He came in from Hada with his family and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 與甲喇額真阿岱出駐伊蘭布里庫，防蒙古游牧軼界，率十人巡徼，遇敵百人，追斬殆盡。

translations.literal: Together with jalan ejen Adai he went out to garrison Yilanbuliku, guarding against Mongol nomads crossing the border; leading ten men on patrol he encountered a hundred enemies and pursued them, killing nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: With jalan ejen Adai he was posted to Yilanbuliku to block Mongol nomads from crossing the frontier. On patrol with ten men he met a hundred foes, chased them down, and killed nearly every one.

sentences.zh: 聞明兵千餘將攻海州，率三百人馳擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Hearing that more than a thousand Ming troops were about to attack Haizhou, he led three hundred men in a rapid assault and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that over a thousand Ming troops were moving on Haizhou, he raced forward with three hundred men and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 天聰間，屢從太宗伐明，薄明都，擊滿桂軍；

translations.literal: During Tiancong he repeatedly followed the Taizong in campaigns against Ming, approached the Ming capital, and attacked Man Gui's army;
translations.idiomatic: Under Tiancong he repeatedly followed the Taizong against Ming, drew near the capital, and struck Man Gui's army;

sentences.zh: 攻遵化，破敵壘，入大安口：皆先眾奮擊。

translations.literal: He attacked Zunhua, broke enemy fortifications, and entered Da'an Pass—all times charging ahead of the mass.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted Zunhua, smashed enemy lines, and entered Da'an Pass—each time leading the charge.

sentences.zh: 以功，予世職二等甲喇章京，擢兵部承政。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted hereditary second-rank jalan zhangjing and promoted to chengzheng of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: For his services he received hereditary second-rank jalan zhangjing and was made chengzheng of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 蒙古旗制定，恩格圖隸正紅旗，即授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: When the Mongol banners were fixed, Enggtu was attached to the Plain Red Banner and immediately granted gusa ejen of that banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banners were organized, Enggtu was enrolled in the Plain Red Banner and at once made its gusa ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐明，與阿岱等為伏，殲明邏卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Ming; with Adai and others he lay in ambush and annihilated Ming border patrols.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the Ming campaign and, with Adai and others in ambush, wiped out Ming border patrols.

sentences.zh: 復從伐朝鮮，薄其都城，與固山額真譚泰等樹雲梯以登。

translations.literal: Again he followed the campaign against Korea, approached their capital, and with gusa ejen Tan Tai and others erected scaling ladders to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed the Korean campaign, closed on the capital, and with gusa ejen Tan Tai and others raised scaling ladders to the walls.

sentences.zh: 尋坐伐明時，戰松山，正藍、正白、鑲白三旗營汛錯亂，匿不劾；

translations.literal: Soon he was indicted because, during the Ming campaign at Songshan, the camp dispositions of the Plain Blue, Plain White, and Bordered White banners were chaotic and he concealed this without impeachment;
translations.idiomatic: He was soon charged because during the Ming campaign at Songshan the Plain Blue, Plain White, and Bordered White banners had fallen into disorder in camp, and he had hidden the fact instead of reporting it;

sentences.zh: 師還出塞，遇敵戰敗：罰鍰，奪俘獲。

translations.literal: The army returned outside the pass, encountered the enemy and was defeated: he was fined and stripped of captives and booty.
translations.idiomatic: On the return beyond the pass his force met the enemy and was beaten; he was fined and lost his prisoners and spoils.

sentences.zh: 又坐伐朝鮮時，方食，上召不即赴，廝卒妄出，為朝鮮兵所殺，論罪，上命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: He was also indicted because, during the Korean campaign, while eating he did not go immediately when the sovereign summoned him; a servant rashly went out and was killed by Korean troops; judged guilty, the sovereign ordered a fine in lieu of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He was charged again for the Korean campaign: while at his meal he failed to answer the sovereign's summons at once, a servant went out rashly and was killed by Korean troops; found guilty, he was allowed to redeem the penalty with a fine.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，攻密雲，距牆子嶺五里，恩格圖率兵先諸軍越高峰，入邊破敵。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Beile Yueto against Ming, attacked Miyun, and five li from Qiangziling Enggtu led troops ahead of all the armies over the high peak, entered the border, and broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Beile Yueto against Ming and attacked Miyun. Five li from Qiangziling, Enggtu took his men over the heights ahead of the whole army, crossed the border, and routed the foe.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗等伐明，圍松山，明兵夜出劫營，恩格圖率本旗兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others against Ming and besieged Songshan; Ming troops sallied at night to raid the camp, and Enggtu led his banner troops to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others against Ming in the siege of Songshan. When Ming troops raided the camp by night, Enggtu led his banner force and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 六年，從上伐明，上命恩格圖與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦吳拜擊明總督洪承疇，恩格圖違上方略，遇敵不前。
