translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the sovereign against Ming; the sovereign ordered Enggtu and gabushan galdan i angban Wubai to attack Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou; Enggtu violated the sovereign's battle plan and did not advance when he encountered the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed the sovereign against Ming. The sovereign ordered Enggtu and gabushan galdan i angban Wubai to strike Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou, but Enggtu disobeyed the battle plan and hung back when the enemy appeared.

sentences.zh: 師還，吏議當褫職，命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: When the army returned, officials proposed stripping his office; he was ordered to pay a fine in lieu.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return officials urged dismissal; he was allowed to redeem the penalty with a fine.

sentences.zh: 尋令與諸將更番戍松山。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to rotate with other generals in garrisoning Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon put on rotation with other commanders to hold Songshan.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，進一等甲喇章京，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, was advanced to first-rank jalan zhangjing, and was granted half a rank step.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed into China, fought Li Zicheng, rose to first-rank jalan zhangjing, and received half a rank step.

sentences.zh: 從豫親王多鐸西破賊，移師向江南，賊躡我師後，恩格圖殿，四戰皆勝。

translations.literal: Following Prince Yu Duoduo west to break the bandits, the army moved toward Jiangnan; the bandits tracked behind our army; Enggtu brought up the rear and won four battles.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Yu Duoduo west against the rebels, then turned toward Jiangnan. When the enemy pressed on the army's heels, Enggtu held the rear and won four successive fights.

sentences.zh: 尋破明將鄭鴻逵於瓜洲，復自江南徇浙江，至杭州，破敵，獲舟三十五。

translations.literal: Soon he defeated Ming general Zheng Hongkui at Guazhou; again from Jiangnan he subdued Zhejiang, reached Hangzhou, broke the enemy, and captured thirty-five boats.
translations.idiomatic: He soon defeated Ming general Zheng Hongkui at Guazhou, then swept from Jiangnan into Zhejiang, took Hangzhou, routed the enemy, and seized thirty-five boats.

sentences.zh: 克嘉興，下崑山。

translations.literal: He captured Jiaxing and took Kunshan.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Jiaxing and reduced Kunshan.

sentences.zh: 進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: He was advanced to third-rank meile zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to third-rank meile zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 復自浙江徇福建，與固山額真漢岱共下府一、縣五；

translations.literal: Again from Zhejiang he subdued Fujian; with gusa ejen Handai together he took one prefecture and five counties;
translations.idiomatic: From Zhejiang he pushed into Fujian and, with gusa ejen Handai, captured one prefecture and five counties;

sentences.zh: 與梅勒額真鄂羅塞臣共下府一、縣八；

translations.literal: With meiren ejen Orosen together he took one prefecture and eight counties;
translations.idiomatic: with meiren ejen Orosen he took one prefecture and eight counties;

sentences.zh: 戰於分水關、於南靖：皆有功。

translations.literal: Battles at Fenshui Pass and Nanjing—all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: and at Fenshui Pass and Nanjing he earned merit in every fight.

sentences.zh: 四年，進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was advanced to first-rank ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he rose to first-rank ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 五年，討江西叛將金聲桓，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, while suppressing the Jiangxi rebel general Jin Shenghuan, he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died in camp while campaigning against the Jiangxi rebel Jin Shenghuan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: In early Qianlong his enfeoffment was fixed at second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong his rank was fixed as second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =鄂本兌=鄂本兌，曼靖氏，其先為蒙古。

translations.literal: Eobendui. Eobendui was of the Manjing clan; his forebears were Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Eobendui. Eobendui belonged to the Manjing clan; his ancestors were Mongols.

sentences.zh: 入明為守備。

translations.literal: He entered Ming service as shoubei.
translations.idiomatic: He had entered Ming service as shoubei.

sentences.zh: 天命六年，太祖取遼陽，鄂本兌以兵三十五、馬六十出降。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianming the Taizu took Liaoyang; Eobendui came out to surrender with thirty-five soldiers and sixty horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 6, when the Taizu took Liaoyang, Eobendui came over with thirty-five soldiers and sixty horses.

sentences.zh: 其後蒙古旗制定，隸正黃旗。

translations.literal: Afterward, when the Mongol banners were fixed, he was attached to the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banners were later organized, he was enrolled in the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，從伐廣寧有功，授世職游擊。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed the campaign against Guangning with merit and was granted hereditary yuji.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served with merit in the Guangning campaign and received hereditary yuji.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，太宗伐明，屯錦州，命額駙蘇納選蒙古將士禦敵塔山西，鄂本兌與焉，敵以二千人至，奮擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong the Taizong campaigned against Ming and encamped at Jinzhou; he ordered imperial son-in-law Suna to select Mongol officers and soldiers to repel the enemy west of Tashan; Eobendui was among them; the enemy came with two thousand men and was fiercely attacked and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 the Taizong marched against Ming and encamped at Jinzhou. He told imperial son-in-law Suna to pick Mongol troops to hold the enemy west of Tashan; Eobendui was among them. When two thousand foes came up, they charged hard and broke them.

sentences.zh: 上移師寧遠，明總兵滿桂陣於城東，鄂本兌率五牛錄甲士破敵，進二等參將。

translations.literal: The sovereign moved the army to Ningyuan; Ming commander-in-chief Man Gui formed battle lines east of the city; Eobendui led five niru of armored soldiers to break the enemy and was advanced to second-rank canjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign shifted to Ningyuan. Ming commander Man Gui drew up east of the city; Eobendui led five niru of armored troops through the enemy line and was raised to second-rank canjiang.

sentences.zh: 二年，從上伐多羅特部，以二百人先驅，遇敵，敵稍北，復出精銳死戰，我師且卻，鄂本兌躍騎突​​前，敵敗遁，上督諸貝勒並進，殺其台吉古魯，俘獲無算。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed the sovereign against the Dorote tribe with two hundred men as vanguard; they encountered the enemy; the enemy retreated slightly north, then sent out elite troops in a desperate fight; our army was about to fall back; Eobendui leapt on his horse and charged forward; the enemy was defeated and fled; the sovereign directed all the beile to advance together, killed their taiji Guru, and captives and booty were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed the sovereign against the Dorote with two hundred vanguard horsemen. The enemy gave ground northward, then threw in fresh elite troops in a death fight; as the army began to waver, Eobendui spurred ahead alone. The foe broke and ran; the sovereign drove all the beile forward together, killed their taiji Guru, and the captures were beyond count.

sentences.zh: 進一等參將，擢右翼蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: He was advanced to first-rank canjiang and promoted to Right Wing Mongol gusa ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to first-rank canjiang and was made Right Wing Mongol gusa ejen.

sentences.zh: 三年，從上伐明，明邊將五道迎戰，鄂本兌率所部兵擊敵，斬參將一，獲其纛，入大安口，遂進薄明都，克永平、灤州、遵化、遷安四城。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the sovereign against Ming; five Ming border generals came to give battle on five routes; Eobendui led his troops to strike the enemy, beheaded one canjiang, seized his banner standard, entered Da'an Pass, then advanced close to the Ming capital and captured Yongping, Luanzhou, Zunhua, and Qian'an—four cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed the sovereign against Ming. Five Ming border commanders met them on five roads; Eobendui led his men into the fight, killed a canjiang, took his standard, passed Da'an Pass, pressed toward the Ming capital, and captured Yongping, Luanzhou, Zunhua, and Qian'an.

sentences.zh: 上命鄂本兌與固山額真察哈喇等守遵化，貝勒阿敏駐永平，護諸將。

translations.literal: The sovereign ordered Eobendui with gusa ejen Chahala and others to guard Zunhua; Beile Amin was stationed at Yongping protecting the generals.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign left Eobendui with gusa ejen Chahala and others to hold Zunhua while Beile Amin stayed at Yongping to cover the commanders.

sentences.zh: 明兵來攻，阿敏檄棄城引師退，敵已逼城下，鄂本兌以五十人出戰，斬邏卒七人，獲其馬，遂與察哈喇等全軍以還。

translations.literal: Ming troops came to attack; Amin by dispatch ordered abandoning the city and withdrawing the army; the enemy already pressed below the walls; Eobendui with fifty men went out to fight, beheaded seven border patrol soldiers, seized their horses, and then with Chahala and others the whole army returned safely.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces attacked, Amin ordered the city abandoned and the army withdrawn. With the enemy already at the walls, Eobendui went out with fifty men, killed seven border scouts, took their horses, and brought Chahala and the whole force back intact.

sentences.zh: 鄂本兌為殿，明師追至，屢擊卻之，引出邊，師無所損，進三等副將。

translations.literal: Eobendui served as rear guard; the Ming army pursued; he repeatedly struck and repelled them, escorted the force beyond the border, and the army suffered no losses; he was advanced to third-rank fujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Eobendui covered the retreat. The Ming army pressed hard, but he beat them back again and again, saw the column safely across the border without loss, and was raised to third-rank fujiang.

sentences.zh: 五年，從上伐明，圍大凌河，屯城西。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the sovereign against Ming, besieged Dalinghe, and encamped west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed the sovereign against Ming in the siege of Dalinghe, encamping west of the city.

sentences.zh: 敵出戰，爭已下諸台堡，鄂本兌與固山額真和碩圖督兵並進，敵敗退入城，迫逐之及壕，敵死者甚眾。

translations.literal: The enemy sallied; they fought over already captured tower forts; Eobendui with gusa ejen Hositu directed troops to advance together; the enemy was defeated and retreated into the city; pursuit reached the moat and very many enemy were killed.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison sallied to contest the captured tower forts, Eobendui and gusa ejen Hositu drove their men forward together, broke the enemy back into the city, and chased them to the moat with heavy slaughter.

sentences.zh: 師還，得優賚。

translations.literal: When the army returned he received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 八年，改三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year his title was changed to third-rank jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was redesignated third-rank jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first month of the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，兄孫託克塔哈爾襲世職。

translations.literal: During Kangxi his elder brother's grandson Toktakhar inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi his elder brother's grandson Toktakhar succeeded to the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 從撫遠大將軍費揚古討噶爾丹有功，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Following the pacification-far general Fiyanggu in suppressing Galdan with merit, he was advanced to third-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Serving under pacification-far general Fiyanggu against Galdan, he earned merit and rose to third-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: In early Qianlong his enfeoffment was fixed at second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong his rank was fixed as second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =和濟格爾=和濟格爾，失其氏，蒙古烏魯特部人。

translations.literal: Hejige'er. Hejige'er—his clan is lost—was a man of the Mongol Urad tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Hejige'er. Hejige'er's clan is no longer known; he came from the Urad Mongols.

sentences.zh: 入明為千總。

translations.literal: He entered Ming service as qianzong.
translations.idiomatic: He had entered Ming service as qianzong.

sentences.zh: 太祖取廣寧，從石廷柱出降，授甲喇額真，隸烏真超哈。

translations.literal: When the Taizu took Guangning, he came out to surrender with Shi Tingzhu, was granted jalan ejen, and was attached to the ujen cahaa.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu took Guangning he came over with Shi Tingzhu, was made jalan ejen, and was assigned to the ujen cahaa.

sentences.zh: 其後漢軍旗制定，隸正白旗，並從漢姓為何氏。

translations.literal: Afterward, when the Han Army banners were fixed, he was attached to the Plain White Banner and also took the Han surname He.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Army banners were later organized, he was enrolled in the Plain White Banner and adopted the Han surname He.

sentences.zh: 和濟格爾事太祖，從伐巴林、棟奎諸部，有功。

translations.literal: Hejige'er served the Taizu and followed campaigns against the Barin, Dongkui, and other tribes with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Hejige'er served the Taizu and campaigned with merit against the Barin, Dongkui, and other tribes.

sentences.zh: ，從伐明，诇敵薊州，斬邏卒三，敵三百來攻，和濟格爾衝鋒入，斬百總一。

translations.literal: , he followed the campaign against Ming, reconnoitered the enemy at Jizhou, beheaded three border patrol soldiers; three hundred enemy came to attack; Hejige'er charged in and beheaded one baizong.
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he scouted the enemy at Jizhou, killed three border scouts, and when three hundred foes attacked charged in and killed a baizong.

sentences.zh: 五年，復從伐明，圍大凌河，敗錦州援兵；

translations.literal: In the fifth year he again followed the campaign against Ming, besieged Dalinghe, and defeated Jinzhou relief troops;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he again joined the Ming campaign, besieged Dalinghe, and broke Jinzhou's relief force;

sentences.zh: 城兵出樵採，爭台堡，並擊敗之。

translations.literal: City troops came out for wood-gathering and fought over tower forts; he defeated them all.
translations.idiomatic: when garrison parties came out for firewood and contested the tower forts, he defeated them as well.

sentences.zh: 與敵戰城下，我師執纛者墜壕，和濟格爾掖之出，復以鳥槍殪敵兵三。

translations.literal: Fighting the enemy below the city, the banner-bearer of our army fell into the moat; Hejige'er helped him out and again with arquebus killed three enemy soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fighting below the walls our standard-bearer fell into the moat; Hejige'er pulled him out and with his arquebus killed three more enemy soldiers.

sentences.zh: 八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was granted hereditary niru zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he received hereditary niru zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，復從貝勒岳託伐明。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he again followed Beile Yueto against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he again followed Beile Yueto against Ming.

sentences.zh: 四年，烏真超哈析置四固山、八梅勒，以和濟格爾為鑲白旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the ujen cahaa was divided into four gusa and eight meiren; Hejige'er was made Bordered White Banner meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the ujen cahaa was split into four gusa and eight meiren, and Hejige'er became Bordered White Banner meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍錦州，累敗敵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the siege of Jinzhou and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou and repeatedly routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again took part in the Jinzhou siege.

sentences.zh: 敵自松山分踞高橋南三台，和濟格爾以火器克之，殲敵百餘。

translations.literal: The enemy from Songshan occupied in division the three platforms south of Gaoqiao; Hejige'er with firearms captured them and annihilated more than a hundred enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy detachments from Songshan held the three redoubts south of Gaoqiao; Hejige'er took them with firearms and killed more than a hundred.

sentences.zh: 七年，從克塔山、杏山二城，加半個前程，授正白旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed the capture of Tashan and Xingshan, was granted half a rank step, and was made Plain White Banner meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he helped take Tashan and Xingshan, received half a rank step, and was made Plain White Banner meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 八年，從克中後所、前屯衛二城，進一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed the capture of Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei and was advanced to first-rank jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the capture of Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei and rose to first-rank jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second month he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second month.

sentences.zh: 拜音達里，和濟格爾子，襲二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Baiyindari, Hejige'er's son, inherited second-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Baiyindari, Hejige'er's son, succeeded to second-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 事聖祖，自參領擢宣化總兵官。

translations.literal: Serving the Sage Ancestor, he was promoted from canling to commander of the Xuande garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sage Ancestor he rose from canling to commander of the Xuande garrison.

sentences.zh: 十三年，耿精忠反，移拜音達里為隨徵福建總兵官，尚可喜請增兵戍廣東，上命與福建巡撫楊熙駐廣州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Geng Jingzhong rebelled; Baiyindari was transferred as campaign-attached Fujian zongbing; Shang Kexi requested increased troops to garrison Guangdong; the sovereign ordered him with Fujian governor Yang Xi to station at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, when Geng Jingzhong rebelled, Baiyindari was shifted to campaign-attached Fujian zongbing. Shang Kexi asked for more troops to hold Guangdong, and the sovereign ordered Baiyindari and Fujian governor Yang Xi to Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，可喜子之信叛，拜音達里與熙督所部斬關突圍出，會大軍於贛州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Kexi's son Zhixin rebelled; Baiyindari with Xi directed their troops to cut through the gate and break out, joining the main army at Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when Kexi's son Zhixin turned rebel, Baiyindari and Xi led their men in a gate-cutting breakout and joined the main force at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 上獎其忠勇，進一等。

translations.literal: The sovereign rewarded his loyalty and valor and advanced him to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign praised his loyalty and courage and raised him to first rank.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授駐防廣州副都統。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was granted deputy lieutenant-general garrisoning Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made deputy lieutenant-general at the Guangzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，遷廣州將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was transferred to General of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was moved to General of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，卒，以其子何天培襲。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he died; his son He Tianpei inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirty-seventh year, and his son He Tianpei succeeded.

sentences.zh: 天培時已官參領，累遷江南京口將軍。

translations.literal: Tianpei was by then a canling officer; he was repeatedly transferred to General of the Jiangnan Jingkou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: By then Tianpei held the rank of canling and was repeatedly moved to General of the Jiangnan Jingkou garrison.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，命署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongzheng reign he was ordered to serve as acting governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Yongzheng reign he was appointed acting governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 入為兵部尚書，出為江寧將軍；

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Minister of War and went out again as General of Jiangning;
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Minister of War and left again as General of Jiangning;

sentences.zh: 復入為正白旗漢軍都統，署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: he re-entered as lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Banners and again acted as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: he returned to the capital as lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Banners and again served as acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，上以天培阿附年羹堯、隆科多下刑部逮治，擬斬監候。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year the sovereign, because Tianpei had curried favor with Nian Gengyao and Longkodo, sent him to the Ministry of Justice for arrest and trial; the sentence proposed was death with reprieve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year the sovereign had Tianpei arrested and tried by the Ministry of Justice for currying favor with Nian Gengyao and Longkodo; the sentence was death with reprieve.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，赦出獄。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he was pardoned and released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he was pardoned and released from prison.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 天培既得罪，以拜音達里曾孫何鈞降襲二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: After Tianpei had fallen from grace, Baiyindari's great-grandson He Jun inherited in reduced rank as second-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: After Tianpei's disgrace, Baiyindari's great-grandson He Jun succeeded in reduced rank to second-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，更名立柱。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign his name was changed to Lizhu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign his name was changed to Lizhu.

sentences.zh: 官至貴州提督。

translations.literal: He rose to the office of Provincial Commander-in-Chief of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Provincial Commander-in-Chief of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: =阿賴=阿賴，莽努特氏，世居喀爾喀部。

translations.literal: Alai. Alai was of the Mangnut clan and for generations had lived in the Khalkha territory.
translations.idiomatic: Alai. Alai belonged to the Mangnut clan and had long lived in the Khalkha lands.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，挈其孥來歸，隸蒙古正黃旗。

translations.literal: During the reign of Taizong he brought his wife and children and submitted; he was attached to the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizong he came over with his family and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘗奉使阿祿部，降其部長，上嘉其能，賜號「達爾漢」，免賦役。

translations.literal: He once served as envoy to the Aru tribe, made their chief submit, and the sovereign praised his ability, bestowing the title "Darhan" and exempting him from taxes and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Once sent as envoy to the Aru tribe, he brought their chief to submit. The sovereign praised his skill, granted him the title Darhan, and exempted him from taxes and corvée.

sentences.zh: 率兵五百逐逃人，窮追數月，斬倡叛者四人，盡俘以還。

translations.literal: Leading five hundred troops he pursued fugitives, chasing them relentlessly for months, beheaded four ringleaders of rebellion, and captured them all and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the head of five hundred men he hunted fugitives for months on end, beheaded four rebel ringleaders, and brought back the rest as captives.

sentences.zh: 又率兵攻喀木尼喀部，俘其部長葉雷，獲戶口牲畜無算。

translations.literal: Again leading troops he attacked the Kamunika tribe, captured their chief Yelei, and took households and livestock beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He again led troops against the Kamunika tribe, captured their chief Yelei, and seized countless households and livestock.

sentences.zh: 崇德九年，授一等甲喇章京，又半個前程，加賜號庫魯克達爾漢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chongde he was granted first-rank jalan zhangjing and half a rank step, and was additionally given the title Kuruk Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 9 he received first-rank jalan zhangjing plus half a rank step, and was further granted the title Kuruk Darhan.

sentences.zh: 尋授禮部左參政、正黃旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: He was soon made Left Vice Minister of Rites and gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Left Vice Minister of Rites and gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從攻錦州，設伏杏山邀擊，攻松山，敗敵。

translations.literal: He followed the attack on Jinzhou, set an ambush at Xingshan to intercept the enemy, attacked Songshan, and defeated the foe.
translations.idiomatic: On the Jinzhou campaign he laid an ambush at Xingshan to intercept the enemy, fought at Songshan, and routed the foe.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從固山額真葉臣徇山西，師還，賜白金三百；

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Shunzhi reign he followed Gushan Ejen Yechen in pacifying Shanxi; when the army returned he was granted three hundred taels of silver;
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he followed Gushan Ejen Yechen in the Shanxi pacification; on the army's return he received three hundred taels of silver;

sentences.zh: 三年，從擊騰機思；

translations.literal: in the third year he followed the attack on Tenggis;
translations.idiomatic: in the third year he joined the campaign against Tenggis;

sentences.zh: 六年，討姜瓖：皆有功，進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: in the sixth year he helped suppress Jiang Xiang: in all these he had merit and was advanced to second-rank ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: and in the sixth year helped put down Jiang Xiang. For these services he was raised to second-rank ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: ，加太子太保。

translations.literal: , and was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，諡武壯。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died; his posthumous title was Wuzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year and was given the posthumous name Wuzhuang.

sentences.zh: =布延=布延，郭爾羅特氏，蒙古察哈爾部人。

translations.literal: Buyan. Buyan was of the Gorolo clan and a man of the Mongol Chakhar tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan. Buyan belonged to the Gorolo clan and came from the Mongol Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 初在其部為塔布囊。

translations.literal: At first in his tribe he was a tabunang.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served in his tribe as a tabunang.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，偕昂坤杜棱來歸，隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong he came over together with Angkun Duleng and was attached to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he submitted together with Angkun Duleng and was enrolled in the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從伐棟奎部，為導。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against the Dongkui tribe and served as guide.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against the Dongkui he served as guide.

sentences.zh: 從伐克什克騰部，首陷陣。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against the Keshiketeng tribe and was the first to break the enemy line.
translations.idiomatic: On the Keshiketeng campaign he was first to break the enemy line.

sentences.zh: 再從甲喇額真圖魯什略明邊，俘其邏卒，斬百餘級，得樵車百餘、騾驢以百數。

translations.literal: Again following Jalan Ejen Tulushi in raiding the Ming border, he captured their border patrol soldiers, beheaded more than a hundred, and took more than a hundred firewood carts and mules and donkeys numbering in the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Jalan Ejen Tulushi in a raid on the Ming frontier, took border scouts captive, killed more than a hundred, and seized over a hundred firewood carts and scores of mules and donkeys.

sentences.zh: 复略十三站，斬十級，得把總一、馬三。

translations.literal: Again he raided thirteen stations, beheaded ten, and took one bazong and three horses.
translations.idiomatic: On another raid through thirteen stations he killed ten men and captured one bazong and three horses.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was granted the hereditary office of niru zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: For these deeds he received the hereditary rank of niru zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕布哈塔布囊略寧遠。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Buha Tabunang, he raided Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Buha Tabunang in a raid on Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 既出邊，明兵千餘追至，布哈陷陣。

translations.literal: After they had crossed the border, more than a thousand Ming troops pursued them; Buha fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Once beyond the border they were pursued by more than a thousand Ming troops, and Buha was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 哈談巴圖魯還戰，馬中矢僕，布延赴援，與之馬，力戰敗敵，賚俘一、馬二、牛三，進世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Hatan Batur turned back to fight; his horse was struck by an arrow and fell; Buyan rushed to his aid, gave him a horse, fought fiercely and defeated the enemy, was rewarded with one captive, two horses, and three oxen, and was advanced in hereditary rank to third-rank jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Hatan Batur wheeled about to fight, but his horse was shot and fell. Buyan rode to his rescue, gave him a mount, and together they beat the enemy back. He was rewarded with one captive, two horses, and three oxen, and rose in hereditary rank to third-rank jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 茂奇塔特，，從征噶爾丹有功，加拖沙喇哈番，例進二等。

translations.literal: Maoqitate, , followed the campaign against Galdan with merit, was granted tosaha hafan, and by regulation was advanced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Maoqitate served with merit on the Galdan campaign, received tosaha hafan, and by regulation rose to second rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign his fief was fixed as second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his peerage was fixed at second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =阿爾沙瑚=阿爾沙瑚，瓦三氏。

translations.literal: Arshahu. Arshahu was of the Wasan clan.
translations.idiomatic: Arshahu. Arshahu belonged to the Wasan clan.

sentences.zh: 初為察哈爾林丹汗護衛。

translations.literal: At first he was a guard of the Chakhar Khan Ligdan.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served as a guard to the Chakhar Khan Ligdan.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗敗走唐古特，阿爾沙瑚帥所屬四十餘戶渡哈屯河來歸，隸蒙古鑲白旗，授世職游擊。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan was defeated and fled to Tangut, Arshahu led more than forty households under him across the Hatun River and submitted; he was attached to the Mongol Bordered White Banner and granted the hereditary office of yuji.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan was routed and fled toward Tangut, Arshahu led his forty-odd households across the Hatun River to submit. He was enrolled in the Mongol Bordered White Banner and granted the hereditary rank of yuji.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從伐明，自牆子嶺入，屢敗明兵，行略地至濟南。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Ming, entered by Qiangziling, repeatedly defeated Ming troops, and marched raiding as far as Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he joined the Ming campaign, entered through Qiangziling, repeatedly routed Ming forces, and raided all the way to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，師還出塞，复擊敗太平寨明兵。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, as the army returned beyond the frontier, he again defeated Ming troops at Taipingzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, on the army's return beyond the frontier, he again defeated Ming troops at Taipingzhai.

sentences.zh: 五年，從伐索倫部，獲部長博穆博果爾及其孥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the campaign against the Solon tribe and captured the tribal chief Bumbogor and his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the Solon campaign and captured the chief Bumbogor together with his family.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the Ming campaign and took part in the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 明以騎兵出松山，謀劫紅衣砲，阿爾沙瑚力戰卻之，又敗洪承疇所將步兵，以功進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: The Ming sent cavalry out from Songshan intending to seize the red-barbarian cannon; Arshahu fought fiercely and drove them back, and again defeated the infantry led by Hong Chengchou; for his merit he was advanced in hereditary rank to first-rank jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Ming cavalry sallied from Songshan to seize the red-barbarian cannon; Arshahu fought them off and then routed the infantry under Hong Chengchou. For this he rose in hereditary rank to first-rank jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 八年，卒，以兄子果爾沁襲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died; his elder brother's son Guo'erqin inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year, and his elder brother's son Guo'erqin succeeded.

sentences.zh: 果爾沁時已為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Guo'erqin was by then niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: By then Guo'erqin was already niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 從伐朝鮮，嘗以侍衛二十人敗敵。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Korea and once with twenty guards defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On the Korea campaign he once routed the enemy with only twenty guards.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，加半個前程。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Shunzhi reign he followed the entry through the passes, attacked Li Zicheng, and was granted half a rank step.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed into China, fought Li Zicheng, and received half a rank step.

sentences.zh: 再遷鑲白旗蒙古梅勒章京，進世職二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to meiren zhangjing of the Mongol Bordered White Banner and advanced in hereditary rank to second-rank ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved again to meiren zhangjing of the Mongol Bordered White Banner and rose in hereditary rank to second-rank ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to gushan ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he became gushan ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 上命定西將軍愛星阿帥師與吳三桂合兵逐明桂王由榔，以果爾沁為副，敕愛星阿軍中機事皆俾果爾沁與議。

translations.literal: The sovereign ordered Pacifier of the West General Ai Xing'a to command troops and join with Wu Sangui to drive out the Ming Prince of Gui Youlang; Guo'erqin was made deputy, and Ai Xing'a was instructed that all military affairs in the army should be deliberated with Guo'erqin.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign ordered Pacifier of the West General Ai Xing'a to lead troops with Wu Sangui in pursuit of the Ming Prince of Gui, Youlang. Guo'erqin was made his deputy, and Ai Xing'a was instructed to consult Guo'erqin on all military decisions.

sentences.zh: 十八年九月，師次大理，休馬力。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year the army halted at Dali and rested the horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year the army halted at Dali to rest the horses.

sentences.zh: 踰月，出騰越，道南甸、隴川、猛卯。

translations.literal: After more than a month they set out from Tengyue, passing through Nandian, Longchuan, and Mengmao.
translations.idiomatic: After a month they marched out from Tengyue by way of Nandian, Longchuan, and Mengmao.

sentences.zh: 十一月，薄木邦，明將白文選方據錫箔江為守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month they approached Hsenwi; the Ming general Bai Wenxuan was just holding the line at the Tipao River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they drew near Hsenwi, where the Ming general Bai Wenxuan held the Tipao River in defense.

sentences.zh: 果爾沁與固山額真遜塔，巴牙喇纛章京畢力克圖、費雅思哈，噶布什賢昂邦白爾赫圖等，簡精銳疾馳三百餘裡，至江濱。

translations.literal: Guo'erqin with Gushan Ejen Sunta, Bayara Da Janggin Biliketu and Feiyasihha, and Gabsi Hiyan Angban Baierhetu and others selected elite troops and rode swiftly more than three hundred li to the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: Guo'erqin, Gushan Ejen Sunta, Bayara Da Janggin Biliketu and Feiyasihha, Gabsi Hiyan Angban Baierhetu, and others picked elite troops and raced more than three hundred li to the river.

sentences.zh: 文選毀橋走茶山，令總兵官馬寧以師從之，至猛養，文選降。

translations.literal: Wenxuan destroyed the bridge and fled toward Chashan; he ordered the zongbing Ma Ning to follow with troops; at Mengyang, Wenxuan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxuan destroyed the bridge and fled toward Chashan, sending zongbing Ma Ning in pursuit. At Mengyang he surrendered.

sentences.zh: 師進次晚舊，得由榔以歸。

translations.literal: The army advanced and halted at Wanjio, taking Youlang captive and returning.
translations.idiomatic: The army pressed on to Wanjio, captured Youlang, and returned.

sentences.zh: ，進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: , and was advanced to first-rank ashan i hafan with tosaha hafan as well.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to first-rank ashan i hafan with tosaha hafan as well.

sentences.zh: 尋列議政大臣，調本旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: He was soon listed among the Grand Councillors and transferred to Manchu lieutenant-general of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a Grand Councillor and transferred to Manchu lieutenant-general of his banner.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，卒，諡襄敏。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year he died; his posthumous title was Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second month of the ninth year and was given the posthumous name Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign his fief was fixed as second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his peerage was fixed at second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =額琳奇岱青=額琳奇岱青，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Elinqidai. Elinqidai was of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Elinqidai. Elinqidai belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 居翁牛特部，為察哈爾部宰桑。

translations.literal: He lived in the Ujimchin tribe and was a zaisang of the Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: He lived among the Ujimchin and served the Chakhar as a zaisang.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗敗走，所部皆潰，額琳奇岱青將來歸；

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan was defeated and fled, his forces all scattered; Elinqidai was about to come over;
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan was routed and fled, his followers scattered, and Elinqidai was preparing to submit;

sentences.zh: 會宰桑多爾濟塔蘇爾海率所屬游牧，與我師遇，倚山拒戰，敗遁，額琳奇岱青追及之，與謀偕降。

translations.literal: it happened that Zaisang Dorji Tasurhai led his dependents in nomadic grazing, encountered our army, relied on the mountains to resist, was defeated and fled; Elinqidai pursued and caught up with him, and they plotted to submit together.
translations.idiomatic: when Zaisang Dorji Tasurhai, leading his people in nomadic grazing, met our army, made a stand in the hills, and was beaten and put to flight. Elinqidai overtook him, and the two agreed to surrender together.

sentences.zh: 六月，上自將伐明，道塞外，師次波碩兌。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming by way of the lands beyond the frontier; the army halted at Bosoid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the sovereign personally led a Ming campaign through the outer territories, and the army halted at Bosoid.

sentences.zh: 額琳奇岱青、多爾濟塔蘇爾海及顧實、布顏代、塞冷等五宰桑率丁壯七百人及其孥二千口來歸，上遣將護詣瀋陽，厚賚之，分隸蒙古正白旗。

translations.literal: Elinqidai, Dorji Tasurhai, and five zaisang including Gushi, Buyandai, and Saileng led seven hundred fighting men and two thousand wives and children to submit; the sovereign sent generals to escort them to Shenyang, richly rewarded them, and distributed them among the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Elinqidai, Dorji Tasurhai, and five zaisang—Gushi, Buyandai, Saileng, and others—brought seven hundred fighting men and two thousand dependents to submit. The sovereign sent escorts to Shenyang, rewarded them generously, and enrolled them in the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，授世職二等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he was granted the hereditary office of second-rank angbang zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he received the hereditary rank of second-rank angbang zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，從伐明，自青山口入，越明都，略地山東，累戰皆勝。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Ming, entered by Qingshankou, crossed the Ming capital region, raided through Shandong, and in repeated battles all were victories.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the Ming campaign, entered through Qingshankou, crossed the capital region, and raided Shandong, winning every engagement.

sentences.zh: 六年，圍錦州，與阿爾沙瑚同功，進一等，世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, besieging Jinzhou, he shared merit with Arshahu, was advanced to first rank, and the inheritance was made perpetual.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at the Jinzhou siege, he shared credit with Arshahu, rose to first rank, and received perpetual inheritance.

sentences.zh: 八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 順治間，追諡勤良。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign he was posthumously given the title Qinliang.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi he was posthumously named Qinliang.

sentences.zh: 子札木素，襲。

translations.literal: His son Zhamusu inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhamusu succeeded.

sentences.zh: 聖祖即位，加恩諸大臣舊自察哈爾來者，札木素與內大臣噶爾瑪、散秩大臣沙哩岱等，並賜莊田、奴僕。

translations.literal: When the Sage Ancestor took the throne he showed favor to the various ministers who had formerly come from the Chakhar; Zhamusu together with Inner Minister Garmar, Minister without Portfolio Shalidai, and others were all granted estate lands and bond servants.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sage Ancestor ascended the throne he rewarded the old Chakhar submitters among the ministers; Zhamusu, Inner Minister Garmar, Minister without Portfolio Shalidai, and others all received estate lands and bond servants.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was granted the office of Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 he was made Inner Minister.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign his fief was fixed as first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his peerage was fixed at first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: =德參濟旺=德參濟旺，博爾濟吉特氏，世居阿布罕。

translations.literal: Qingdecen. Qingdecen was of the Borjigit clan and for generations had lived at Abuhan.
translations.idiomatic: Qingdecen. Qingdecen belonged to the Borjigit clan and had long lived at Abuhan.

sentences.zh: 初為察哈爾部宰桑。

translations.literal: At first he was a zaisang of the Chakhar tribe.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served the Chakhar as a zaisang.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗敗走，以所屬從。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan was defeated and fled, he followed with those under him.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan was routed and fled, he went with his followers.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，上自將伐明，略宣府，攻萬​​全左衛，遂出尚方堡二十里駐軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming, raided Xuande, attacked Wanquan Left Guard, and then marched out twenty li beyond Shangfangbao and encamped.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 the sovereign personally led a Ming campaign, raided Xuande, attacked Wanquan Left Guard, and encamped twenty li beyond Shangfangbao.

sentences.zh: 時林丹汗走死大草灘，德參濟旺與噶爾瑪濟農、多尼庫魯克、多爾濟達爾漢諾顏號四大宰桑，挾林丹汗二福金，率丁壯二千人及其孥來歸，遣三十人先奏上。

translations.literal: At that time Ligdan Khan had fled and died at Dacaotan; Qingdecen together with Garmar Jiyin, Donikuruk, and Daerhan Noyan—the four great zaisang—brought Ligdan Khan's two fujin, led two thousand fighting men and their wives and children to submit, and sent thirty men ahead to report to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: By then Ligdan Khan had fled and died at Dacaotan. Qingdecen, Garmar Jiyin, Donikuruk, and Daerhan Noyan—the four great zaisang—brought Ligdan Khan's two consorts, two thousand fighting men, and their families to submit, sending thirty men ahead to announce their arrival.

sentences.zh: 上進次克蚌，命所司運米三百石以待。

translations.literal: The sovereign advanced and halted at Kebang, ordering the officials to transport three hundred shi of grain to await them.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign moved on to Kebang and ordered three hundred shi of grain brought up to receive them.

sentences.zh: 二福金及德參濟旺等至，謁上行在，上與之宴，賜貂裘、鞍馬、牛羊。

translations.literal: The two fujin and Qingdecen and the others arrived, paid homage at the sovereign's traveling palace, and the sovereign feasted with them, granting sable furs, saddled horses, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: When the two consorts and Qingdecen's party arrived, they paid homage at the sovereign's camp. He feasted them and granted sable furs, saddled horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 還師，复宴新附諸臣，德參濟旺等跪進酒，上曰：「朕本不飲酒，念爾曹誠意，當盡此一卮。」

translations.literal: On the army's return he again feasted the newly submitted ministers; Qingdecen and the others knelt and presented wine; the sovereign said: "I ordinarily do not drink wine, but considering your sincerity, I shall drain this one cup."
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he again feasted the newly submitted ministers. Qingdecen and the others knelt and offered wine. The sovereign said, "I do not ordinarily drink, but in view of your sincerity I shall empty this one cup."

sentences.zh: 复酌酒遍賜之，並賚甲胄、衣裘，授世職一等昂邦章京，隸蒙古正黃旗。

translations.literal: Again he poured wine and bestowed it on them all, and also rewarded them with armor and fur garments, granting the hereditary office of first-rank angbang zhangjing and attaching them to the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He then poured wine and gave it to each in turn, rewarded them with armor and fur garments, granted the hereditary rank of first-rank angbang zhangjing, and enrolled them in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，察哈爾台吉瑣諾木來降，上召宴，德參濟旺與焉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year the Chakhar taiji Suonuomu came to submit; the sovereign summoned a feast, and Qingdecen was among those present.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year the Chakhar taiji Suonuomu submitted. The sovereign held a feast, and Qingdecen was present.

sentences.zh: 上因言：「察哈爾傾覆，爾諸臣來歸，朕皆預知。」

translations.literal: The sovereign then said: "The Chakhar have been overthrown; you ministers came to submit—I foreknew it all."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign then said, "The Chakhar have fallen; you ministers have come to submit—I foresaw it all."

sentences.zh: 德參濟旺奏曰：「聖諭及此，洵有如神之鑑也！」

translations.literal: Qingdecen memorialized: "Your sacred words reach this point—truly it is a mirror like that of a god!"
translations.idiomatic: Qingdecen replied, "Your sacred words go so far—it is truly a divine mirror!"

sentences.zh: 順治二年，坐事，降三等。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, for an offense he was reduced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 he was punished for an offense and reduced three ranks.

sentences.zh: 三年，從豫親王多鐸北討騰機思，鄂特克山之役，及破土謝圖汗，德參濟旺皆與有功焉。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo in the northern expedition against Tenggis; in the battle of Otok Mountain and in breaking the Tushetu Khan, Qingdecen in all had merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo on the northern expedition against Tenggis and distinguished himself at Otok Mountain and in the defeat of the Tushetu Khan.

sentences.zh: 語詳奇塔特徹爾貝傳。

translations.literal: The account is detailed in the biography of Qitate Che'erbei.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is given in the biography of Qitate Che'erbei.

sentences.zh: 復進一等。

translations.literal: He was again advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was again raised one rank.

sentences.zh: 是歲，改一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: That year his title was changed to first-rank jingkini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: That year his rank was changed to first-rank jingkini hafan.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth month of the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign his fief was fixed as first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his peerage was fixed at first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: =多爾濟達爾罕=多爾濟達爾罕，博爾濟吉特氏，居翁牛特，為察哈爾部宰桑。

translations.literal: Daerhan. Daerhan was of the Borjigit clan, lived among the Ujimchin, and was a zaisang of the Chakhar tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Daerhan. Daerhan belonged to the Borjigit clan, lived among the Ujimchin, and served the Chakhar as a zaisang.

sentences.zh: 與德參濟旺等同降，隸蒙古鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: He submitted together with Qingdecen and the others and was attached to the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted together with Qingdecen and the others and was enrolled in the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: ，授世職一等梅勒章京，以為都察院承政。

translations.literal: , and was granted the hereditary office of first-rank meiren zhangjing and made chengzheng of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He received the hereditary rank of first-rank meiren zhangjing and was made chengzheng of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 三年，更定官制，改參政。

translations.literal: In the third year the official system was revised and his title was changed to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when the official system was revised, his title was changed to vice minister.

sentences.zh: 六年，上自將擊洪承疇，命多爾濟達爾罕偕承政阿什達爾罕度善地駐軍，並察諸軍斬級多寡，還報稱旨，擢內大臣，仍兼參政。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the sovereign personally led an attack on Hong Chengchou and ordered Daerhan together with chengzheng Ashi Daerhan to cross to Shandi and encamp, also to inspect the head-counts taken by each army; on his return report pleasing the sovereign, he was promoted to grand minister of the interior while still retaining the post of vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the sovereign took the field in person against Hong Chengchou and ordered Daerhan, together with Censorate vice minister Ashi Daerhan, to cross to Shandi and establish camp, while also tallying the enemy heads taken by each unit. When his report on returning pleased the sovereign, he was promoted to grand minister of the interior and kept his vice-ministerial post.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，祖大壽來降，上幸牧馬所，命諸內大臣與較射，賞中的者，多爾濟達爾罕得駝一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, seventh month, Zu Dashou came over in surrender; the sovereign visited the horse pasture and ordered all grand ministers of the interior to compete in archery, rewarding those who hit the target; Daerhan won a camel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year Zu Dashou surrendered. The sovereign visited the horse pasture and had the grand ministers of the interior compete in archery, rewarding those who hit the mark; Daerhan won a camel.

sentences.zh: 十月，從饒餘貝勒阿巴泰伐明，行略地，自薊州至於兗州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he followed Raoyu Beile Abatai in the campaign against Ming, conducting a plundering sweep from Jizhou to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he followed Raoyu Beile Abatai against Ming on a looting march from Jizhou to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，上言：「師自兗州還，右翼諸固山不遵貝勒期約，先左翼諸軍出塞。

translations.literal: When the army returned he memorialized: "When the army returned from Yanzhou, the banners of the right wing did not keep the beile's appointed schedule and left the pass ahead of the left-wing armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he memorialized: "Marching back from Yanzhou, the right-wing banners broke the beile's timetable and crossed the frontier ahead of the left-wing forces.

sentences.zh: 賴上威靈懾敵，我軍縱橫如行無人地，得全師以還。

translations.literal: Only by the sovereign's majesty were the enemy overawed, so our army ranged about as though crossing empty ground and brought the whole force back safely.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sovereign's majesty overawed the enemy, so our troops ranged freely as though no one stood in their way and the whole army came home intact.

sentences.zh: 萬一有失，悔何及？」

translations.literal: If anything had gone wrong, what regret would have been enough?"
translations.idiomatic: Had anything gone wrong, what remorse could ever have sufficed?"

sentences.zh: 請論罰，上為停右翼諸軍賞。

translations.literal: He asked that punishments be assessed, and the sovereign suspended rewards for the right-wing armies.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that penalties be imposed, and the sovereign withheld rewards from the right-wing banners.

sentences.zh: 順治間，上推太宗舊恩，並考滿，進三等精奇尼哈番，复授都察院承政。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi, the sovereign extended Taizong's old favor, and when his performance review was complete he was advanced to third-rank jingkini hafan and again appointed chengzheng of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi the sovereign extended Taizong's old kindness; when his merit review was complete he rose to third-rank jingkini hafan and was again made chengzheng of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 七年，命以內大臣與議政，恩詔一等，兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to sit on the Deliberative Council as grand minister of the interior; an amnesty raised him one rank, and he also held tuwashala hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed grand minister of the interior with a seat on the Deliberative Council; an amnesty edict raised him one rank and added tuwashala hafan.

sentences.zh: 十七年四月，卒，諡順僖。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, fourth month, he died; his posthumous title was Shunxi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth month of the seventeenth year and was posthumously titled Shunxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等子。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong the peerage was fixed as third-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his fief was fixed at third-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: =奇塔特徹爾貝=奇塔特徹爾貝，哈爾圖特氏。

translations.literal: Qitate Che'erbei. Qitate Che'erbei was of the Hartut clan.
translations.idiomatic: Qitate Che'erbei. Qitate Che'erbei belonged to the Hartut clan.

sentences.zh: 初為察哈爾部宰桑。

translations.literal: At first he was a zaisang of the Chakhar tribe.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served the Chakhar as a zaisang.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗敗，奇塔特徹爾貝以四百戶保哈屯河。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan was defeated, Qitate Che'erbei held the Hatun River with four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan was routed, Qitate Che'erbei held the Hatun River with four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十一月，上使招焉，渡河次西拉木輪，旋從使者來歸，上厚賚之，隸蒙古正藍旗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the sovereign sent to summon him; he crossed the river and encamped at Xilamulun, then soon followed the envoy to submit; the sovereign richly rewarded him and enrolled him in the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the sovereign sent to summon him. He crossed the river and halted at Xilamulun, then followed the envoy to submit. The sovereign richly rewarded him and enrolled him in the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗有八大福金，掌高爾土門固山事福金，其一也。

translations.literal: Ligdan Khan had eight great fujin; she who managed the affairs of the Gorkhimun gūsa fujin was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: Ligdan Khan had eight great consorts; the one who managed affairs for the Gorkhimun banner was among them.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗殂，所部宰桑袞出克僧格妻焉。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan died, Gunču Kesige of his zaisang took her as wife.
translations.idiomatic: After Ligdan Khan died, Gunču Kesige, one of his zaisang, took her to wife.

sentences.zh: 上以袞出克僧格叛主，奪福金畀奇塔特徹爾貝。

translations.literal: The sovereign considered Gunču Kesige guilty of betraying his lord, seized the fujin, and gave her to Qitate Che'erbei.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign judged Gunču Kesige a traitor to his lord, seized the consort, and gave her to Qitate Che'erbei.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，逐李自成，至慶都。

translations.literal: Early in Shunzhi he followed the entry through the pass, pursued Li Zicheng, and reached Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he followed the army through the pass, pursued Li Zicheng, and reached Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 三年，從豫親王多鐸北討騰機思，師次英噶爾察克山，聞騰機思在滾葛魯台，疾馳逐之，至鄂特克山，獲其孥。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo on the northern expedition against Tenggis; when the army halted at Yinga'erchake Mountain and heard Tenggis was at Gungerutai, they galloped in pursuit to Otok Mountain and captured his family.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo on the northern expedition against Tenggis. When the army halted at Yinga'erchake Mountain and learned Tenggis was at Gungerutai, they galloped in pursuit to Otok Mountain and captured his family.

sentences.zh: 土謝圖汗以六萬人次扎濟布拉，為騰機思聲援，奇塔特徹爾貝等率所部擊之，敗走，逐北三十餘裡。

translations.literal: The Tushetu Khan came with sixty thousand men to Zhajibula to support Tenggis; Qitate Che'erbei and others led their troops to attack and routed them, pursuing north more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: The Tushetu Khan brought sixty thousand men to Zhajibula to support Tenggis. Qitate Che'erbei and others led their troops against them, put them to flight, and pursued north for more than thirty li.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，碩類汗復以二萬人至，复擊之，亦敗走。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day the Sečen Khan came again with twenty thousand men; they attacked once more and again put them to flight.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day the Sečen Khan arrived with another twenty thousand men; they attacked again and routed them as well.

sentences.zh: 以功進一等。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was raised one rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，卒。

translations.literal: He died in the third year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 3.

sentences.zh: 子鄂諾勒，襲。

translations.literal: His son Enuole succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Enuole inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 十八年，鄂諾勒以參領從護軍統領莽吉圖南討鄭錦，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Enuole, as company commander, followed the chief commandant Mangitu south against Zheng Jing and died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Enuole, serving as company commander, followed Chief Commandant Mangitu south against Zheng Jing and died in the field.

sentences.zh: =洛哩=洛哩，鄂爾沁氏。

translations.literal: Luoli. Luoli was of the Orqin clan.
translations.idiomatic: Luoli. Luoli belonged to the Orqin clan.

sentences.zh: 初為察哈爾林丹汗護衛。

translations.literal: At first he was a guard of Ligdan Khan of Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served as a guard to Ligdan Khan of Chakhar.

sentences.zh: ，太宗自將伐察哈爾，林丹汗走死，洛哩持元初巴斯巴喇嘛所鑄嘛哈噶拉金佛，率百餘人來歸。

translations.literal: , when Taizong personally led the campaign against Chakhar, Ligdan Khan fled and died; Luoli brought the gold Mahākāla Buddha cast in the early Yuan by Basiba Lama and led more than a hundred men to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong personally campaigned against Chakhar, Ligdan Khan fled and died. Luoli brought the gold Mahākāla image cast in the early Yuan by Basiba Lama and led more than a hundred men to submit.

sentences.zh: 隸蒙古正黃旗，授世職一等參將。

translations.literal: He was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner and granted the hereditary rank of first-rank assistant brigadier-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner and granted the hereditary rank of first-rank assistant brigadier-general.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，自牆子嶺毀邊牆入，擊敗明總督吳阿衡。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he followed Beile Yoto against Ming, entered by destroying the border wall at Qiangziling, and defeated Ming governor-general Wu Aheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he followed Beile Yoto against Ming, broke through at Qiangziling by tearing down the border wall, and defeated Ming governor-general Wu Aheng.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州，城兵出戰，左翼三旗巴牙喇兵擊之不利，退入壕，明師環之，逼洛哩分守地。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou; when garrison troops came out to fight, the vanguard of the left-wing three banners fared badly and fell back into the trench; Ming forces surrounded them and pressed Luoli's assigned sector.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the Ming campaign and besieged Jinzhou. When the garrison sallied forth, the vanguard of the left-wing three banners was beaten back into the trench; Ming troops surrounded them and pressed Luoli's sector.

sentences.zh: 洛哩力戰，沒於陣，卹贈三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Luoli fought fiercely and fell in battle; posthumously he was granted third-rank meiren zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Luoli fought fiercely and fell in battle; posthumously he was granted third-rank meiren zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 洛哩兄沙濟，弟烏班和碩齊、沙哩岱。

translations.literal: Luoli's elder brother was Shaji; his younger brothers were Uban Hoshoci and Shalidai.
translations.idiomatic: Luoli's elder brother was Shaji; his younger brothers were Uban Hoshoci and Shalidai.

sentences.zh: 沙濟襲洛哩遺爵。

translations.literal: Shaji inherited Luoli's remaining title.
translations.idiomatic: Shaji inherited Luoli's remaining title.

sentences.zh: 烏班和碩齊當林丹汗走死，別率七十人來歸，授游擊。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan fled and died, Uban Hoshoci separately led seventy men to submit and was made guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan fled and died, Uban Hoshoci separately led seventy men to submit and was made guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 卒，以其弟沙哩岱襲。

translations.literal: He died, and his younger brother Shalidai inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He died, and his younger brother Shalidai inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 順治初，沙哩岱以牛錄額真從睿親王多爾袞入關擊李自成，復從豫親王多鐸討騰機思，擊敗土謝圖汗、碩類汗，進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Early in Shunzhi Shalidai, as niru captain, followed Prince Regent Dorgon through the pass against Li Zicheng, then followed Prince Yu Dodo against Tenggis, defeated the Tushetu and Sečen Khans, and was advanced to second-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi Shalidai, as niru captain, followed Prince Regent Dorgon through the pass against Li Zicheng, then followed Prince Yu Dodo against Tenggis, defeated the Tushetu and Sečen Khans, and rose to second-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 尋沙濟亦卒，沙哩岱兼襲，合為二等精奇尼哈番，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: Soon Shaji also died; Shalidai inherited both lines, combined as second-rank jingkini hafan, and was made minister without portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shaji also died. Shalidai inherited both lines, combined as second-rank jingkini hafan, and was made minister without portfolio.

sentences.zh: ，聖祖即位，加恩諸大臣舊自察哈爾來歸者，沙哩岱及內大臣噶爾瑪、散秩大臣札木素等，並賜莊田、奴僕。

translations.literal: , when the Sage Ancestor took the throne, he showed favor to ministers who had formerly come over from Chakhar; Shalidai together with grand minister Garma, minister without portfolio Zhamusu, and others all received estate lands and bondservants.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sage Ancestor took the throne, he showed favor to ministers who had formerly come over from Chakhar; Shalidai, together with Grand Minister Garma, Minister without Portfolio Zhamusu, and others, all received estate lands and bondservants.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 1.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等子。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong the peerage was fixed as second-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong his fief was fixed at second-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 太宗時諸將自蒙古來歸以戰死者，又有奇塔特偉徵、巴賴都爾莽奈、巴賴都爾莽奈子阿南達、孫阿喇納，皆有聲績，自有傳。

translations.literal: Among generals who came over from Mongolia and died in battle during Taizong's reign were also Qitate Weizheng, Bayan Duren Manggūnai, Bayan Duren Manggūnai's son Ananda, and grandson Alana, all of whom had distinguished records and have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Other Mongol commanders who submitted during Taizong's reign and died in battle include Qitate Weizheng, Bayan Duren Manggūnai, Bayan Duren Manggūnai's son Ananda, and grandson Alana; all won distinction and have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 其事世祖戰死，則有袞楚克圖英、琿津、沙爾布。

translations.literal: Those who died in battle under Shizu were Huichuketu, Yinghuanjin, and Sharubu.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fell in Shizu's service were Huichuketu, Yinghuanjin, and Sharubu.

sentences.zh: 奇塔特偉徵，博爾濟吉特氏，鄂爾多斯哈爾濟農族人也。

translations.literal: Qitate Weizheng was of the Borjigit clan and a man of the Ordos Harjin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Qitate Weizheng belonged to the Borjigit clan and came from the Ordos Harjin tribe.

sentences.zh: 世居克魯倫。

translations.literal: His family long lived at Kerulen.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long lived at Kerulen.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，與其弟額爾格勒珠爾、喀蘭圖、扎克托會率所屬來歸，隸蒙古正黃旗。

translations.literal: During Taizong's reign he came over with his brothers Ergelezhu'er, Kalandu, and Zhaketuo leading their followers and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: During Taizong's reign he submitted with his brothers Ergelezhu'er, Kalandu, and Zhaketuo, leading their followers, and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 正月，上遣蒙古軍略錫爾哈、錫伯圖，收察哈爾流散部眾，奇塔特偉徵與岱青塔布囊斬七十三人，降百餘人，獲馬駝數十。

translations.literal: In the first month the sovereign sent Mongol troops to sweep Xierha and Xibotu and gather the scattered Chakhar bands; Qitate Weizheng and Daiqing Tabunang beheaded seventy-three, accepted the surrender of more than a hundred, and captured dozens of horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month the sovereign sent Mongol troops to sweep Xierha and Xibotu and gather scattered Chakhar bands. Qitate Weizheng and Daiqing Tabunang beheaded seventy-three men, accepted the surrender of more than a hundred, and captured dozens of horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 五月，上自將伐明，次古爾班圖勒噶，命蒙古軍別出間道，與大軍會錫喇烏蘇河，奇塔特偉徵行遇察哈爾五人將遁入阿祿部，擒以獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the sovereign personally campaigned against Ming and halted at Gurbantulega; he ordered Mongol troops to take a separate secret route and join the main force at Xilawusu River; while marching Qitate Weizheng encountered five Chakhar men about to flee into the Aru tribe, seized them, and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the sovereign campaigned against Ming in person and halted at Gurbantulega. He ordered Mongol troops to take a separate route and join the main army at Xilawusu River. On the march Qitate Weizheng encountered five Chakhar men about to flee into the Aru tribe, seized them, and presented them.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，從貝勒多鐸伐明，次寧遠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year he followed Beile Dodo against Ming and halted at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year he followed Beile Dodo against Ming and halted at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 奇塔特偉徵時為噶布什賢噶喇昂邦，率所部前驅，至大凌河西，明將劉應選、趙國志將七千人迎戰，我兵寡，奇塔特偉徵力戰，沒於陣，卹贈三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Qitate Weizheng was then gabushiyan gūsa iangbang; he led his men as vanguard to west of Daling River, where Ming generals Liu Yingxuan and Zhao Guozhi came out with seven thousand to meet them; our forces were few, but Qitate Weizheng fought fiercely and fell in battle; posthumously he was granted third-rank meiren zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Qitate Weizheng was then gabushiyan gūsa iangbang. He led his men as vanguard to the west bank of the Daling River, where Ming generals Liu Yingxuan and Zhao Guozhi came out with seven thousand to meet them. Though our forces were few, Qitate Weizheng fought fiercely and fell in battle; posthumously he was granted third-rank meiren zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 額爾格勒珠爾，崇德間，屢從伐明，徇山東，圍錦州，戰松山，皆有功。

translations.literal: Ergelezhu'er, during Chongde repeatedly followed campaigns against Ming, raided Shandong, besieged Jinzhou, and fought at Songshan, with merit each time.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongde Ergelezhu'er repeatedly joined campaigns against Ming, raided Shandong, besieged Jinzhou, and fought at Songshan, distinguishing himself each time.

sentences.zh: 順治間，從入關擊李自成，予世職牛錄章京，加半個前程。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he followed entry through the pass against Li Zicheng, was given the hereditary niru zhangjing, and granted half a step of seniority.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi he followed the army through the pass against Li Zicheng, received the hereditary niru zhangjing, and was granted half a step of seniority.

sentences.zh: 卒，無子，以喀蘭圖子察琿襲。

translations.literal: He died without sons; Kalandu's son Chahun succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He died without sons, and Kalandu's son Chahun inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 喀蘭圖，崇德間為一等侍衛。

translations.literal: Kalandu, during Chongde served as first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongde Kalandu served as first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 順治初，世祖推太宗舊恩，复屢遇恩詔，世職累進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Early in Shunzhi Shizu extended Taizong's old favor; repeatedly favored by amnesties, his hereditary rank advanced cumulatively to second-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi Shizu extended Taizong's old kindness; repeated amnesty edicts raised his hereditary rank cumulatively to second-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞攝政，請上幸其第，喀蘭圖方退直，聞上扈從無多人，即持弓矢趨詣左右防衛。

translations.literal: When Prince Regent Dorgon held the regency he invited the emperor to his residence; Kalandu had just left duty, and hearing the emperor had few escorts he took bow and arrows and hurried to guard at his side.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Regent Dorgon held the regency he invited the emperor to his residence. Kalandu had just come off duty; hearing the emperor had few escorts, he took bow and arrows and hurried to guard his side.

sentences.zh: 及世祖親政，敕獎喀蘭圖忠篤，賜金帛、鞍馬、莊田，命以其族改隸滿洲正黃旗，進世職一等。

translations.literal: When Shizu took personal rule, he issued an edict praising Kalandu's loyalty and granted him gold, silks, saddled horses, and estate lands, ordered his clan transferred to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, and advanced his hereditary rank to first class.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu took personal rule he issued an edict praising Kalandu's loyalty, granted him gold, silks, saddled horses, and estate lands, ordered his clan transferred to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, and advanced his hereditary rank to first class.

sentences.zh: 尋以上行圍扈從愆遲，復為二等。

translations.literal: Soon for tardiness in escorting the sovereign on the hunting encirclement he was again reduced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was again reduced to second rank for tardiness while escorting the sovereign on a hunting encirclement.

sentences.zh: 事聖祖，累官理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Under the Sage Ancestor he rose cumulatively to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sage Ancestor he rose cumulatively to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乞老，授內大臣，加太子太保。

translations.literal: He begged to retire on account of age, was made grand minister of the interior, and given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He begged to retire on account of age, was made grand minister of the interior, and given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡敏壯。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously titled Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子察琿兼襲，合為三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: His son Chahun inherited both lines, combined as third-rank ashan-i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chahun inherited both lines, combined as third-rank ashan-i hafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，安親王岳樂討吳三桂，次袁州，與吳三桂將馬寶戰鈐岡山，死之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi Prince An Yuele campaigned against Wu Sangui and halted at Yuanzhou; he fought Wu Sangui's general Ma Bao at Qiangang Mountain and died there.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 Prince An Yuele campaigned against Wu Sangui and halted at Yuanzhou. He fought Wu Sangui's general Ma Bao at Qiangang Mountain and died there.

sentences.zh: 進二等。

translations.literal: Advanced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously advanced to second rank.

sentences.zh: 扎克托會，事太宗，授正黃旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Zhaketuo served Taizong and was appointed meiren ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaketuo served Taizong and was appointed meiren ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從伐朝鮮，坐所部戰艦不時至，解官。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Korea and was dismissed because his warships did not arrive on time.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Korea and was dismissed because his warships failed to arrive on time.

sentences.zh: 尋以追敘來歸功，累遇恩詔，授世職一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Soon, in recognition of his merit for coming over, and repeatedly favored by amnesties, he was granted the hereditary first-rank adaha hafan combined with tuwashala hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, in recognition of his merit for submitting, and through repeated amnesty edicts, he received the hereditary first-rank adaha hafan combined with tuwashala hafan.

sentences.zh: 卒，子錫喇布，襲。

translations.literal: He died; his son Xilabu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He died, and his son Xilabu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 順治間，從靖南將軍珠瑪喇徇廣東，擊明將李定國，戰於新會，錫喇布力戰破敵，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he followed General Pacifying the South Jurumara in sweeping Guangdong, attacked Ming general Li Dingguo at Xinhui; Xilabu fought fiercely, broke the enemy, and was advanced to third-rank ashan-i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi he followed General Pacifying the South Jurumara in sweeping Guangdong and fought Ming general Li Dingguo at Xinhui. Xilabu fought fiercely, broke the enemy, and rose to third-rank ashan-i hafan.

sentences.zh: =兗楚克圖英=兗楚克圖英，和勒依忒氏。

translations.literal: Huichuketu. Huichuketu was of the Heleite clan.
translations.idiomatic: Huichuketu. Huichuketu belonged to the Heleite clan.

sentences.zh: 初為察哈爾宰桑。

translations.literal: At first he was a Chakhar zaisang.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served the Chakhar as a zaisang.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗敗走，部眾皆潰散。

translations.literal: When Ligdan Khan was defeated and fled, his followers all scattered.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan was routed and fled, his followers all scattered.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，太宗自大同還師，屯尚方堡，袞楚克圖英將二百餘人，與故宰桑德參濟旺等來歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, as Taizong returned from Datong he encamped at Shangfangbao; Huichuketu brought more than two hundred men with former zaisang Qingdecen and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8, as Taizong returned from Datong and encamped at Shangfangbao, Huichuketu brought more than two hundred men with former zaisang Qingdecen and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 蒙古旗制定，隸正紅旗，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: When the Mongol banner system was established he was enrolled in the Plain Red Banner and made jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banner system was established he was enrolled in the Plain Red Banner and made jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，授世職一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he was granted the hereditary first-rank meiren zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he received the hereditary first-rank meiren zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 二年，坐事，降一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the second year, for an offense, he was reduced one rank to jalan zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was punished for an offense and reduced one rank to jalan zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，從伐明，入牆子嶺，明兵自密雲至，袞楚克圖英引避，當譴，上以降將貸之，收其牲畜，分畀諸自察哈爾降者。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Ming and entered through Qiangziling; when Ming troops came from Miyun, Huichuketu withdrew to avoid them; he deserved punishment, but the sovereign, as a surrendered general, pardoned him, seized his livestock, and distributed them among those who had surrendered from Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the Ming campaign and entered through Qiangziling. When Ming troops came from Miyun, Huichuketu withdrew to avoid them. He deserved punishment, but the sovereign, treating him as a surrendered general, pardoned him, seized his livestock, and distributed it among those who had come over from Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從伐明，圍錦州，戰松山。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed the campaign against Ming, besieged Jinzhou, and fought at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again joined the Ming campaign, besieged Jinzhou, and fought at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 八年，略寧遠，屢擊敗明兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he raided Ningyuan and repeatedly defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he raided Ningyuan and repeatedly defeated Ming troops.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，與固山額真恩格圖合軍力戰敗賊。

translations.literal: Early in Shunzhi he followed entry through the pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and joined forces with gūsa ejen Enggū to fight fiercely and defeat the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he followed the army through the pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and joined gūsa ejen Enggū to fight fiercely and defeat the rebels.

sentences.zh: 二年，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the second year he was advanced to third-rank meiren zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he rose to third-rank meiren zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，從討張獻忠，屢戰皆勝。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Zhang Xianzhong; every battle was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Zhang Xianzhong and won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，從討姜瓖，攻大同，城兵出劫土默特營，袞楚克圖英赴援，中流矢，沒於陣，進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year he followed the campaign against Jiang Xiang, attacked Datong; when garrison troops raided the Tumet camp, Huichuketu went to reinforce, was struck by an arrow, and fell in battle; posthumously advanced to second-rank ashan-i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year he joined the campaign against Jiang Xiang and attacked Datong. When garrison troops raided the Tumet camp, Huichuketu went to reinforce, was struck by an arrow, and fell in battle; posthumously he was advanced to second-rank ashan-i hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男，袞楚克圖英六世孫望吉爾襲。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong the peerage was fixed as second-rank baron; the sixth-generation descendant Wangji'er inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong the peerage was fixed at second-rank baron; Huichuketu's sixth-generation descendant Wangji'er inherited.

sentences.zh: 從討霍集占兄弟，戰死葉爾羌，贈一等男。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against the Khoja brothers, he died in battle at Yarkand and was posthumously granted first-rank baron.
