translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against the Khoja brothers he died in battle at Yarkand and was posthumously granted first-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =琿津=琿津，薩爾圖氏，世居敖漢部。

translations.literal: Yinghuanjin. Yinghuanjin was of the Sartu clan and his family long lived in the Aohan district.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghuanjin. Yinghuanjin belonged to the Sartu clan and his family had long lived in the Aohan district.

sentences.zh: 太宗收敖漢，琿津從眾來歸，行失道，入明錦州。

translations.literal: When Taizong received Aohan's submission Yinghuanjin came over with the crowd but lost the way and entered Ming Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong received Aohan's submission Yinghuanjin came over with the crowd but lost his way and entered Ming Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: ，我師圍錦州，琿津與蒙古台吉諾木齊、武巴什等縋城出降，授世職牛錄章京，隸蒙古鑲藍旗。

translations.literal: , when our army besieged Jinzhou, Yinghuanjin with Mongol taiji Nomuqi, Wubashi, and others let themselves down by rope from the wall to surrender; he was granted the hereditary niru zhangjing and enrolled in the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When our army besieged Jinzhou, Yinghuanjin, together with Mongol taiji Nomuqi, Wubashi, and others, let themselves down by rope from the wall to surrender. He received the hereditary niru zhangjing and was enrolled in the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 旋授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: He was soon made jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，署梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Early in Shunzhi he followed entry through the pass against Li Zicheng and acted as meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he followed the army through the pass against Li Zicheng and served as acting meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 督後隊，有功，加半個前程。

translations.literal: He commanded the rearguard with merit and was granted half a step of seniority.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the rearguard with distinction and was granted half a step of seniority.

sentences.zh: 六月，與固山額真覺羅巴哈納略山東。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, with gūsa ejen Jiral Ebahana, he swept Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, with gūsa ejen Jiral Ebahana, he swept Shandong.

sentences.zh: 七月，移師徇山西，自成將陳永福據太原，琿津單騎行城下，城兵驟出，擊之，敗走，遂克太原，其屬州縣十有五皆下，賚白金。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the army shifted to sweep Shanxi; Li Zicheng's general Chen Yongfu held Taiyuan; Yinghuanjin rode alone beneath the wall; garrison troops rushed out; he attacked and put them to flight, then took Taiyuan and fifteen subordinate prefectures and counties, and was rewarded with white silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the army shifted to sweep Shanxi. Li Zicheng's general Chen Yongfu held Taiyuan. Yinghuanjin rode alone beneath the wall; when garrison troops rushed out he attacked and put them to flight, then took Taiyuan along with fifteen subordinate prefectures and counties, and was rewarded with white silver.

sentences.zh: 二年，與固山額真都雷逐自成至九江口，得其舟。

translations.literal: In the second year, with gūsa ejen Dulei he pursued Zicheng to Jiujiangkou and captured his boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, with gūsa ejen Dulei, he pursued Zicheng to Jiujiangkou and captured his boats.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，時叛將賀珍據漢中，以二千人守雞頭關，拒我師。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Hauge against Zhang Xianzhong; the rebel general He Zhen held Hanzhong with two thousand men guarding Jitou Pass to block our army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Hauge against Zhang Xianzhong. The rebel general He Zhen held Hanzhong and blocked our army at Jitou Pass with two thousand men.

sentences.zh: 琿津率右翼兵從貝勒尼堪擊​​之，敗走，遂進兵入四川，與固山額真巴特瑪等擊獻忠，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Yinghuanjin led right-wing troops following Beile Nikan to attack and put them to flight, then advanced into Sichuan and with gūsa ejen Batma and others fought Xianzhong; every battle was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghuanjin led right-wing troops under Beile Nikan to attack and put them to flight, then advanced into Sichuan and, with gūsa ejen Batma and others, fought Xianzhong to repeated victory.

sentences.zh: 獻忠既誅，復與巴牙喇甲喇額真希爾根定涪州，以功進三等阿達哈哈番，真除鑲藍旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: After Xianzhong was executed he again with vanguard jalan ejen Xiergen pacified Fuzhou; for merit he was advanced to third-rank adaha hafan and confirmed as meiren ejen of the Bordered Blue Mongol Banner.
translations.idiomatic: After Xianzhong was executed he again joined vanguard jalan ejen Xiergen in pacifying Fuzhou. For merit he rose to third-rank adaha hafan and was confirmed as meiren ejen of the Bordered Blue Mongol Banner.

sentences.zh: 復從鄭親王濟爾哈朗徇湖廣，時自成餘眾降於明，分屯寶慶、沅州諸郡縣。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in sweeping Huguang; at that time Zicheng's remaining followers had surrendered to Ming and were scattered through Baqing, Yuanzhou, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in sweeping Huguang. By then Zicheng's remaining followers had surrendered to Ming and were scattered through Baqing, Yuanzhou, and other prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 六年，琿津與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦努山、梅勒額真拜音岱等攻克寶慶，徇沅州，破敵於洪江，斬所署總兵二、副將四、兵二千餘，得舟九。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Yinghuanjin with gabushiyan gūsa iangbang Nushan, meiren ejen Baiyindai, and others captured Baqing, swept Yuanzhou, broke the enemy at Hongjiang, beheaded two appointed grand coordinators, four vice generals, more than two thousand soldiers, and captured nine boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Yinghuanjin, with gabushiyan gūsa iangbang Nushan, meiren ejen Baiyindai, and others, captured Baqing, swept Yuanzhou, broke the enemy at Hongjiang, beheaded two appointed grand coordinators and four vice generals, killed more than two thousand soldiers, and captured nine boats.

sentences.zh: 師還，進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was advanced to first-rank adaha hafan with the additional title tuwashara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was promoted to first-rank adaha hafan with the added tuwashara hafan title.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從信郡王多尼下雲南。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he followed Prince Xin Duoni south into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he marched into Yunnan under Prince Xin Duoni.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月，克永昌。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, Yongchang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang fell in the fourth month of the sixteenth year.

sentences.zh: 師渡潞江，明將李定國為伏磨盤山。

translations.literal: The army crossed the Lu River; the Ming general Li Dingguo laid an ambush at Mopanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Lu River, the army met an ambush laid by Ming general Li Dingguo at Mopanshan.

sentences.zh: 師至，破其柵，琿津與固山額真沙爾布率眾深入，伏起，遂戰死，諡壯勤。

translations.literal: When the army arrived, it broke their palisade; Huijin and the gushan ejen Sharubu led troops deep in, the ambush sprang up, and they died in battle, receiving the posthumous title Zhuangqin.
translations.idiomatic: The army broke their stockade, but when Huijin and Gushan Ejen Sharubu pressed deep inside, the ambush struck and both were killed; Huijin was posthumously titled Valiant and Diligent.

sentences.zh: 沙爾布，博爾濟吉特氏。

translations.literal: Sharubu was of the Borjigit clan.
translations.idiomatic: Sharubu belonged to the Borjigit clan.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，自察哈爾率百餘丁來歸，授牛錄額真，即使轄其眾，隸蒙古鑲白旗。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, he came to submit from the Chakhar leading more than a hundred men, was appointed niru ejen and at once placed in charge of his followers, attached to the Mongol Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he submitted from the Chakhar with over a hundred followers, was made niru ejen to command them, and was assigned to the Mongol Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋擢一等侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to first-rank imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 至，三遷，授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: By the time of the Shizu, after three promotions he was appointed gushan ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shizu, after three further promotions he became gushan ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 恩詔予世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: By grace edict he was granted the hereditary office of tuwashara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty edict granted him the hereditary rank of tuwashara hafan.

sentences.zh: 十年十一月，命與寧南大將軍陳泰帥師守湖南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the tenth year, he was ordered with the Pacifier of the South Grand General Chen Tai to command troops defending Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the tenth year he was ordered to defend Hunan with Grand General Chen Tai, Pacifier of the South.

sentences.zh: 十二年，明將劉文秀、盧明臣、馮雙禮等將數万人分道侵岳州、武昌，沙爾布與巴牙喇纛章京蘇克薩哈設伏邀擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Ming generals Liu Wenxiu, Lu Mingchen, Feng Shuangli, and others led tens of thousands of men in separate columns to invade Yuezhou and Wuchang; Sharubu and the bayara dao zhangjing Sukeesaha set an ambush to intercept them and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Ming generals Liu Wenxiu, Lu Mingchen, Feng Shuangli, and others invaded Yuezhou and Wuchang with tens of thousands in several columns; Sharubu and Bayara Dao Zhangjing Sukeesaha ambushed them and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 敵復攻常德，舟千餘蔽江而下，沙爾布督軍截擊，六戰皆捷，縱火焚其舟。

translations.literal: The enemy again attacked Changde; more than a thousand boats covered the river sailing downstream; Sharubu directed the army to intercept, won six battles in succession, and set fire to burn their boats.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy struck Changde again with over a thousand boats crowding the river, Sharubu intercepted them, won six successive fights, and burned their fleet.

sentences.zh: 明臣赴水死，雙禮被創遁，文秀走桃源。

translations.literal: Mingchen drowned himself; Shuangli was wounded and fled; Wenxiu retreated to Taoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Mingchen drowned, Feng Shuangli fled wounded, and Liu Wenxiu withdrew to Taoyuan.

sentences.zh: 沙爾布與巴牙喇纛章京都爾德等以師從之，文秀走貴州。

translations.literal: Sharubu and the bayara dao zhangjing Duerde and others followed with the army; Wenxiu fled to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sharubu pursued with Bayara Dao Zhangjing Duerde and others until Wenxiu fled into Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從多尼下雲南。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he followed Duoni south into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he joined Duoni's march into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 明年，與琿津同戰死，諡襄壯，進世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: The next year, he died in battle together with Huijin, received the posthumous title Xiangzhuang, and his hereditary office was advanced to baitalabule hafan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he fell beside Huijin; posthumously titled Loyal and Valiant, his line was raised to baitalabule hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，高宗命八旗世職先世以死事卹敘，襲次已滿者，皆予恩騎尉，世襲罔替，沙爾布等皆與焉。

translations.literal: During Qianlong, the Gaozong ordered that for hereditary offices of the Eight Banners whose forebears had been honored for dying in service, when succession turns were exhausted, all should be granted enqiwei in perpetual inheritance; Sharubu and others were all included.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong era the Gaozong ruled that banner lines whose ancestors had died in service, once ordinary succession was exhausted, should receive perpetual enqiwei rank; Sharubu was among them.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：蒙古喀爾喀、科爾沁諸部，東與扈倫四部接。

translations.literal: Commentary says: The Mongol Khalkha and Khorchin tribes border the Four Hulun tribes to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: The Khalkha and Khorchin Mongols lay eastward against the Four Hulun tribes.

sentences.zh: 太祖兵初起，一戰知不敵，率先歸附。

translations.literal: When the Taizu's army first rose, after one battle they knew they could not resist and were the first to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Once Nurhaci's forces emerged, a single defeat convinced them they could not stand and they were among the first to submit.

sentences.zh: 明安、恩格德爾皆申以姻盟，賞延於世。

translations.literal: Ming'an and Enggeder both strengthened ties through marriage alliances, and rewards extended to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'an and Enggeder sealed their loyalty with marriage alliances, and favor passed down through their lines.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾桑初為質子，恩禮與相亞。

translations.literal: Ochirsang first came as a hostage, yet favor and courtesy were second only to the highest.
translations.idiomatic: Ochirsang began as a hostage, yet received honors nearly equal to the foremost.

sentences.zh: 阿濟拜等於蒙古為庶姓，皆以功受賞。

translations.literal: Aji Bai and others were of common Mongol clans, yet all received rewards for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Aji Bai came from lesser Mongol lines yet earned rewards through service.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾林丹汗庭，西處宣、大邊外，太宗乘其衰，以兵收之。

translations.literal: The Chakhar court of Ligdan Khan lay west beyond the Xuan and Da borders; the Taizong seized the moment of its decline and took it by force.
translations.idiomatic: Ligdan Khan's Chakhar realm lay beyond the Xuan-Da frontier; the Taizong struck at its weakness and brought it under arms.

sentences.zh: 布延等有戰績，而洛哩諸人效命疆埸，尤有足多者。

translations.literal: Buyan and others won battle honors, but Luoli and his fellows who gave their lives on the frontier are especially worthy of praise.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan and others won fame in battle, yet Luoli and his comrades who died on the frontier deserve special praise.

sentences.zh: 最初蒙古來附，即隸滿洲；

translations.literal: At first Mongols who submitted were immediately attached to the Manchu banners;
translations.idiomatic: Early Mongol submitters were enrolled directly in Manchu banners;

sentences.zh: 有自明至者，又入漢軍。

translations.literal: those who came from Ming territory entered the Chinese banners.
translations.idiomatic: those arriving from Ming lands entered the Chinese banners.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，定蒙古旗制，先已籍滿洲、漢軍者，亦不復追改也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong the Mongol banner system was fixed; those already registered in Manchu or Chinese banners were not required to change afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol banner system was set in Tiancong 9, those already in Manchu or Chinese registers were left as they were.
